articleTitle: Research on Building Crack Width Monitoring Method Based on Computer Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: As construction projects enter a new era, building crack width monitoring has entered a stage of high-quality development. It is necessary to propose image processing propositions that better meet the needs of crack width monitoring for building safety by focusing on the deep learning idea with image segmentation as the core. Based on the dynamic evolution of image processing development, according to the internal logic of the convolutional neural network, a theoretical analysis framework for the development of image segmentation is constructed. It can explain the image segmentation development mechanism jointly generated by the image processing mechanism and the optimization loop mechanism involved in image sampling and segmentation. From the perspective of quality change and practical deduction of image segmentation development, the possibility of moving towards the high-quality development goal of building crack width monitoring is further explored. The purpose of developing building crack width monitoring is to provide crack width estimates that meet expected standards for construction projects, which is committed to continuously improving the quality of crack width and improving the satisfaction of crack width monitoring. Therefore, it is necessary to strengthen the image segmentation control based on the quality of the inner loop of the convolutional neural network. Establishing an interaction and feedback mechanism between image segmentation and perception of the quality of a construction project, as well as establishing an evaluation system for image segmentation and monitoring of the crack width of a building, which will achieve high-quality development of building crack width monitoring, promote construction project safety, and truly meet the needs of construction projects.

articleTitle: Prediction of Manufacturing PMI Based on AdaBoost Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: From the beginning of the industrial revolution to the present Industry 4.0, the manufacturing industry has been developing and upgrading continuously, which reflects a country's comprehensive competitive soft power, while the manufacturing PMI can reflect the changing trend of the manufacturing economy. In order to control the manufacturing PMI in real time, this paper proposes an AdaBoost regression prediction algorithm based on different classifiers. Firstly, authoritative data of manufacturing PMI are collected. Then analyze and visualize the original data; Then split the data and select K nearest neighbor, decision tree, random forest and limit tree as monomer algorithms to train the model on the training set. Finally, after a large number of tests, the test set data is used to predict new data. The four monomer models scored 0.9582, 0.9529, 0.9560 and 0.9542 on the test set, which can help analyze and predict the changes of PMI in manufacturing industry.

articleTitle: The Application of IoT+Artificial Intelligence Technology in Adoption Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In response to today's high quality demand for agricultural products, this article designs a adoption agriculture system that combines microcontroller, Internet of Things technology, and artificial intelligence technology. This system is mainly controlled by an STM32 microcontroller and processes and judges data transmitted by sensors that detect fire, light intensity, temperature and humidity, ultraviolet intensity, and carbon dioxide concentration; And combined with IoT cloud platform technology, data can be uploaded to the cloud through the MQTT protocol to achieve remote monitoring on both mobile and PC ends; And artificial intelligence technology is used to identify crop diseases and pests. It greatly reduces human consumption, realizes the detection of intelligent agriculture, crop protection, resource optimization, and remote monitoring, and provides a feasible solution for Internet+modern agriculture.

articleTitle: Design of Edge-End Collaborative Physical Simulation Platform for Distribution Network Including Renewable Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to realize the physical simulation of different forms and multiple operating conditions such as AC and DC hybrid smart stations and station microgrids, the design of a collaborative physical simulation platform for distribution network edges containing renewable energy is proposed. The basic overview of the cloud-edge computing model is analyzed, and the role and impact of renewable energy penetration rate on the distribution network edge-end collaboration model is explained. A distribution network edge-end collaborative physical simulation platform with the source network load as the core was established, and the system architecture and system functions were explained. The intelligent power distribution secondary equipment verification test module was analyzed. It focuses on the functions of new distribution terminal signal simulation and photovoltaic grid-connected switch intelligent testing. An analysis is performed for regional applications, illustrating the effectiveness of the proposed platform.

articleTitle: Online Monitoring Technology for Dynamic Capacity Increase of Transmission Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: A dynamic capacity increase control network of transmission lines and its capacity increase control method, which takes immediate control over transmission lines, estimates the safe carrying capacity of transmission lines by obtaining safety detection data, and determines whether the transmission lines should increase capacity through safe carrying capacity. If so, it can provide preset capacity increase signals to increase capacity of transmission lines. When the capacity of the transmission line is increased, the cable sag information of the transmission line is obtained by calculating the safety monitoring data, and the detection information and cable sag information are simultaneously sent to the application port for presentation. As the information collection and data monitoring can be implemented on the transmission line in real time, the conductor sag information of the transmission line will be monitored in real time when the capacity increase is implemented, and the hazards of various main reasons to the safety of the transmission line will be fully considered, thus greatly improving the safety.

articleTitle: Optimization Design Model of Heliostat Field Based on Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper presents an optimization model for the design of a heliostat field in a solar thermal power tower plant. The model aims to maximize the annual average power output per unit heliostat area under constraints including optical efficiency, tower height, and heliostat spacing. An accurate optical efficiency calculation model is established considering factors like cosine loss, shadowing loss, atmospheric transmittance, and receiver interception efficiency. Monte Carlo ray tracing simulates the light propagation to compute the efficiency. The initial heliostat layout follows the Campo circular staggered pattern. The optimization uses a simulated annealing algorithm to search the optimal heliostat size, height and positions by iteratively perturbing the decision variables. Three cases are studied: 1) fixed heliostat parameters, 2) variable size and height, and 3) variable parameters in each ring. Results show the model effectively improves the optical efficiency and power output. The application of stochastic optimization algorithms enhances the heliostat field design. Future work will focus on incorporating economic factors and ground terrain into a multi-objective optimization framework.

articleTitle: Unit Commitment Optimization Scheduling for Thermal Power Plants
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Unit commitment is an essential aspect of developing day-ahead power generation dispatch plans, which include decisions on unit start-up/shut-down states and economic load allocation. Considering the overall economic performance of the system, with the objective of minimizing the total operating cost of the system units, taking into account constraints on start-up/shut-down costs, ramp rates, and start-up/shut-down times, a short-term thermal power unit commitment model is proposed. In simulation experiments, the MATLAB framework with YALMIP and Cplex solvers are used to solve a 30-node system with 6 units for the unit commitment problem, resulting in the optimal start-up/shut-down and output plans in terms of economic efficiency.

articleTitle: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Classification Method Based on Attention Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of error-prone and time-consuming classification of Acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) blood cell microscopic images in medicine, this paper proposes a method based on the attention mechanism residual convolutional neural network model to obtain the information in medical images. Complicated pathological information. This method first preprocesses the sample data, cleans out the training set and verification set that meet the requirements, and also uses the threshold segmentation method to extract the target area of the training sample, and then inputs the preprocessed data into the network. In the model, it is trained, and finally the verification set is input into the model for verification. The experimental results show that this classification method can effectively classify whether ALL blood cell microscopic images are diseased.

articleTitle: Research on Digital System of Collaborative Cycle Integration Information Transformation in Electric Power Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The stage model and operation mode of enterprise private cloud platform construction are developed, and the architecture of collaborative cycle integration system of power enterprises is designed. The platform implements integrated management, standardized supply and automated operation of various computing resources such as host, storage device, network, database, middleware and application software. It provides strong support for standardized construction and lean management of information construction of power grid enterprises. Practice has proved that the integrated and collaborative distributed cloud management platform across data centers can enhance the scalability, scalability and flexibility of information resources, improve the ability and efficiency of information technology operation and maintenance management, and improve the business response ability and service mode level.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Computer Big Data Information Technology in E-Commerce Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: A simple processing background based on Scrapy crawler framework is designed, which uses distributed scraping means to carry out objective and comprehensive evaluation of the main consumption characteristics of users from a large amount of data. Using the use case diagram, the functional requirements of user management and column management are visualized, and reasonable suggestions are made for the design scheme of the overall architecture and functional structure of the system, and the database design is used to support the realization of each functional module. The reliability by analyzing a large amount of data.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent VR Virtual Design System of Intelligent Sports Shoes Based on Computer Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The first part of the paper is to study the shoe modeling process. Some key problems in shoe mold simulation design are studied in depth. The contours of last, heel and upper are simulated by using the corresponding relationship among the three elements of foot, last and shoe and the contour generation algorithm in Photoshop. Different styles of shoes were simulated. The theory and method of shoe modeling simulation are obtained by using Photoshop software to study the depth of image and texture simulation. Through the secondary development and management of Photoshop software, the secondary development and management of three-dimensional modeling elements and material texture elements of shoe last parts are realized. Finally, the feasibility and validity of the above theoretical and technical research are verified by case practice.

articleTitle: Multi-Level Material Storage Allocation Control of Smart Power Plant Based on Hesitant Fuzzy Method
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to improve the ability of multi-level material storage and allocation and dynamic control of smart power plants, a multi-level material storage and allocation control method of smart power plants is proposed based on hesitant fuzzy method, and a material demand parameter analysis model of multi-level material storage and allocation of smart power plants is constructed by using feature selection and multi-model fusion method, and the combined control learning of material storage and allocation control of power grids is realized by using energy efficiency evaluation method. The overall energy efficiency of power plant quality control management system is dynamically evaluated by combination weighting method, the three-level dynamic storage model of power plant is constructed by hesitant fuzzy learning method, the management and fuzzy function are established with the goal of minimizing the cost, the optimal solution of the allocation function is realized by reinforcement learning method, and the trend analysis of its time series can provide research ideas for material demand. In the experimental test, the balance is realized through subjective experience and objective data. The simulation test shows that this method can reduce the cost of material storage in storage, storage and delivery, and obtain the optimal control strategy.

articleTitle: Research on Calibration Technology of Spacecraft Thermal Vacuum Environment Test Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: For calibration of spacecraft thermal vacuum environment test equipment, online vacuity measurement and temperature measurement under vacuum environment was researched. The calibration device composed of multi-channel temperature detectors, vacuum gauges and vacuum data acquisition system was introduced. The multi-layer thermal protection box for multi-channel temperature detectors with insulation layer and heat absorbing layer was designed through thermal conductivity analysis. The thermal protection of multi-channel temperature detectors at high and low temperatures and the signal transmission problem can be solved. The resistance signal of temperatures sensors can be quickly transmitted. The measurement uncertainty of the calibration device was analyzed. All kinds of thermal vacuum environment test equipment can be calibrated within the (−180--200) °C and (10-<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>--10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>) Pa. The traceability time was shortened and the efficiency was improved. The better metering guarantee for thermal vacuum environment test equipment used in military and civil field can be provided.

articleTitle: Medical Data Enhancement and Gastric Cancer Detection Based on Improved WGAN and Multi-Channel Fusion CNNs
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Stomach cancer is now one of the most common malignant tumor diseases of digestive tract, and its prevalence as well as mortality rate are located in the top few tumor diseases. At the same time, China is a country with a high prevalence of gastric cancer, which is expected to turn into a more significant problem with the accelerated aging of the population, so detecting gastric cancer at an early stage can effectively improve the treatment outcome. One of the main problems faced by deep learning for processing medical images is the small size of the dataset. When the amount of data is severely insufficient, the network model is difficult to be trained stably and leads to weak generalization performance, which will directly affect the performance of the algorithm, so the study of medical data enhancement is a very important measure to alleviate the phenomenon of small-sized datasets. In this paper, we design and improve the WGAN network model by introducing the perceptual and structural loss information of medical image data on the basic structure of WGAN network. Through comparative experiments, our designed model has better performance in all evaluation indexes, which verifies the effectiveness and feasibility of the improvement. On the basis of data enhancement, we also designed a multi-channel fusion CNN model combining VGG-16 and GoogLeNet features for early gastric cancer detection. From the experimental results, it can be seen that the fusion CNN we designed can better enhance the effectiveness of early gastric cancer detection, making its accuracy reach 97.08%.

articleTitle: Research on the Strategic Expansion Information System of Electric Power Enterprises Based on Computer Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This article proposes a new type of power enterprise testing model based on computer big data technology, which can effectively enhance the informationization of power enterprise strategic development. The model adopts the core strategy of “resource specification business data application” level interaction, and implements it with the help of computer big data technology, evaluating power enterprise engineering projects, reviewing engineering budgets, and electronic pre settlement, The entire process of data collection is collected by the computer big data system into the model, and the power enterprise is simulated and calculated through the computer big data system. When the calculation occurs, the required information is adjusted based on communication and operation costs, and the dynamic changes in the entire process of strategic expansion are calculated. The Stackelberg expansion model is used to demonstrate that strategic expansion of power enterprises can enhance their digital construction.

articleTitle: Research on Target Detection and Depth Estimation in Binocular Images Based on YOLOv8
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: As artificial intelligence technology enters a new era, target detection in binocular images and depth estimation have entered a high-quality development stage. We are committed to developing deep learning with YOLOv8 and proposing the issue of algorithms that meet the needs of image recognition and depth perception for intelligent vision. Based on the dynamic development of YOLOv8, the theoretical analysis framework of target detection in binocular images and depth estimation system are built according to the binocular image processing protocol specification, which can explain the mechanism for extracting and matching image features as well as estimating and optimizing the depth cycle mechanism generated by the binocular image acquisition and pre-processing model and image recognition module. In addition, from the perspective of performance changes and practical interpretation of target detection in binocular images and depth estimation, we will continue to explore the possibility of moving towards high-quality development of target detection in binocular images and depth estimation. Target detection in binocular images and depth estimation provide standard image recognition and depth perception for intelligent vision and continuously improve the quality of target detection in binocular images and depth estimation to improve users' satisfaction. Therefore, we take measures, such as enhancing the control of the binocular image recognition model based on the YOLOv8 quality inner loop, building interaction and feedback mechanism between the image acquisition module and pre-processing module, and binocular image recognition module, setting up an evaluation system for the target detection in binocular images and depth estimation. This study achieves high-quality development of target detection in binocular images and depth estimation, which is conducive to the progress of intelligent vision.

Author Keywords: Target detection in binocular images and depth estimation

articleTitle: An Interaction Platform Design Method Based on Multi-Level Layering
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Multi-layered stratification can effectively meet the diverse needs of users. This design proposes a solution for providing information services in different administrative regions using a multi-layered stratification construction platform. The information is classified according to different themes or categories, forming a multi-level stratification. The multi-level interactive platform adopts C/S architecture design, achieving automatic management and intelligent interaction of services, providing an intelligent interactive service platform for community groups. Design results show that the multi-level interactive platform design method has important theoretical research significance and practical value for further improving the information level and work efficiency of grassroots community management in administrative regions.

articleTitle: Intelligent Pricing and Replenishment Strategy for Vegetables in Supermarkets Based on ARIMA Prediction and Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Today's technological strength is gradually increasing, the process of digital technology is accelerated, automatic pricing and replenishment decisions in the vegetable commodity category can be digitally mined to obtain a reasonable and beneficial strategy for the interests of the superstore. The aim of this problem is to solve the problems of superstore replenishment and pricing by establishing mathematical models, analyzing the existing data, and solving the problems of superstore replenishment and pricing through the strategies of prediction and optimization, so as to reduce the rate of wastage and improve the profitability. Firstly, the distribution pattern and interrelationship of the sales volume of each category as well as single product of vegetables are analyzed by using Spearman's correlation coefficient, line graphs, bar graphs and descriptive statistics realization. Then, the planning function of the superstore's revenue and the total daily replenishment of each vegetable category is established, and the ARIMA model is used to predict the future sales volume, which is solved by combining with the particle swarm algorithm, and the Monte Carlo algorithm is used to corroborate the correctness of the answer. Finally, the constraints are set to satisfy the market needs, solved by particle swarm algorithm to get the maximum amount of profit for the superstore, establish a linear planning function, and continue to solve by particle swarm algorithm to get the daily replenishment plan in the given vegetable item. The proposed algorithm can avoid falling into local optimal solutions and has global optimality.

articleTitle: Efficient Recommendation Systems for Movies Based on BERT4Rec
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The existing recommendation systems ususally uses collaborative filtering or content filtering for providing recommendation for users. The system is trained and tested with The MovieLens 25M Dataset, which contains a few million data pairs. The success of the recommendation system through the training of BERT4Rec would help the user to filter out unsuitable information. The BERT4Rec is a bidirectional model based on transformer, which allows the training of the recommendation system to be efficient. The model is consisted of 3 layers, the embedding layer, which process the data into information that is later used in the transformer layer, the transformer layer will process the data and forward it to the output layer, where the results would be received by the user. Through testing of a few samples, the recommendation system suggested accurately, which reflects the success of the training and testing phase of this recommendation system. For future improvements, the system could be trained with a data set that includes the ticketing information, which would more accurately reflect what the user had watched in the past. Thus, creating a more precise recommendation system that would give better suggestions for the user.

articleTitle: Application Research of Intelligent Robot in Substation Operation and Maintenance System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Based on machine vision technology, this paper reasonably plans the inspection route of the intelligent substation operation and maintenance inspection robot, so that the inspection robot in the substation can conduct autonomous navigation. The system uses PIC16F73 as the main control chip to monitor the substation inspection devices and lines in real time. The software control algorithm adopts the combination of the grid method and the ant colony clustering method, so that the substation inspection robot can obtain an optimal substation patrol path. Then use database technology and VC++ to develop and establish an electronic map system with global planning functions. The test results show that under the influence of various weather, light and other factors, the overall recognition effect of the intelligent robot for the operation and maintenance inspection in the substation reached 99.19%.

articleTitle: Intelligent Ecological Environment Monitoring System Based on the OneNET Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Ecological environment monitoring is one of the crucial aspects of environmental protection work. Using an STM32 microcontroller as the central processing unit, sensor modules, and wireless communication modules, you can collect and monitor environmental data while also viewing the monitoring number in real time on the client side of your mobile device. On the LCD panel, the real-time monitoring data may also be shown. The results of the experiment confirmed that the design method was reasonable.

articleTitle: Size Recommendation System Based on Mediapipe
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This intelligent wardrobe is divided into two main parts. In terms of hardware, it mainly includes: intelligent wardrobe body, camera, micro code scanning gun and display screen; respectively realize the display function of temporary holding clothes, user body capture, clothing label scanning, scanning size margin, model wearing renderings and archiving QR code of personal preference. In terms of software, For the human body size measurement function, the team relying on the mediapipe framework of human joint points, through the height measurement, human body key point detection model to measure personnel height, chest circumference, waist circumference data, using CNN model, SVM model, linear regression model using linear regression build multiple equation, training the best parameters for regression analysis, get the best size recommended.

articleTitle: Portfolio Optimization Based on a Two-Layer LSTM Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Gold and Bitcoin, as common volatile assets, have become important financial hedges for people. However, the gold and bitcoin markets are full of unknowns, which increases the complexity for market traders to make investment decisions. Therefore, it is critical to accurately determine the changing trends in the financial markets and make the best portfolio trading strategy. we train the LSTM Model to achieve the prediction of future prices. Besides, we build a Portfolio Optimization Model to maximize the total returns. Based on our model, we provide investment trading strategies over 5 years. The results show that after portfolio optimization, the total assets amounted to 282600.8 USD. we designed three separate comparison experiments to verify the performance of our model. The results show that our model is able to achieve greater returns and better control risk.

articleTitle: Optimized Dispatching of Integrated Energy System Based on Cyber-Physical-Social System Under the Influence of Electricity Price
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The development and integration of information technology will make the data of the integrated energy system more real-time and transparent, which will help improve the demand-side management of Integrated Energy Systems (IES). For the demand side of IES, the Cyber-Physical-Social System (CPSS) architecture is constructed and analyzed. An interactive energy management method of CPSS is presented to cover supply-demand interaction and real-virtual interaction. Aiming at the social attributes of power users, the demand-side guidance control strategy mediated by network guidance information is proposed. The impact of the difference in electricity price on the consumption psychology of the users is considered. Simulations of the model are conducted. The results show that the CPSS architecture proposed in this paper can effectively improve the economic benefits of the integrated energy system and make power users actively participate in the CPSS integrated energy system.

articleTitle: Research on Technology of Extracting the Starting Position of Reciprocating Motion Period Based on Cross-Correlation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The correction of articulated industrial robot fault diagnosis, which depend on the accuracy of articulated industrial robot motion period extraction. The cycle extraction of industrial robot action cycling signal includes two research contents: the period time length of detection signal and its period starting position. The method based on Cross-correlation was applied to extract the starting position of reciprocating motion period. The initial phase of the signal was extracted by cross-correlation method, and then transformed into time domain to get the initial position of the signal's period. The acoustic emission signal of industrial robot, whose period starting position extracting experiments showed that the method has high extraction accuracy of period starting position. It had a significant practical application value for condition monitoring of reciprocating rotating machinery system.

articleTitle: Application Research on the Integration of Big Data Information Science and Technology with New Media Art
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The Web information collection and publication system is studied by means of web information collection technology, web denoising technology, based on the fusion of Big Data Information Technology and art, text de-duplication technology and text automatic classification technology. A minimum connection number algorithm based on address and weight is proposed and implemented in the application layer. This method is applied to the development and implementation of the new media information release management system, so that it has a better operating efficiency.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Investor Sentiment Indicator Construction and Stock Prediction Research
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Along with the development of the Internet and social media, massive amounts of unstructured data have been generated. For news reports, stock bar commentaries and research reports, they influence investors' sentiment towards the stock market in terms of macro policies, micro orientations and professional organizations, respectively. In this paper, we utilize natural language processing (NLP) technology and statistical methods to construct investor sentiment indicators that can effectively quantify market sentiment by mining the sentiment of news, commentaries and research reports, study the relationship between investor sentiment and stock returns, and use the sentiment indicators constructed in this paper to predict stock returns, so as to validate the effectiveness of the investor sentiment constructed in this paper. In this paper, specific processing and modeling design is carried out to analyze the sentiment of a single text for the characteristics of different text data. For news and commentary texts, a sentiment analysis model based on Fin-BERT is used for sentiment extraction; for research report texts, a semantic rule-based sentiment analysis model is constructed by combing semantic rules. Finally, this paper utilizes the LSTM time-series prediction model to examine the effectiveness of the investor sentiment indicators constructed in this paper, and combines the sentiment indicators from different information channels to explore the effect of different combinations on improving the stock return prediction ability.

articleTitle: Computer Vision-Based Beef Grading for Marbling Beef Based on RGB-HSV Color Model and Python Software
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In modern life, people have higher and higher requirements for material standards, high quality beef is sought by more and more diners, marbling beef is the best cow product in the world. Marbling density is a part of one of the important indices for evaluation quality of marbing beef, for these indicators usually adopt sensory evaluation, need professional evaluation personnel, it takes time and effort to train these professionals in the long run, Therefore, based on this situation, the development of a new type of computer evaluation system has a good prospect and research value. The main content of this study is based on the basic principle of RGB-HSV color model. The RGB values of the measured samples are then converted into HSV values for data processing to observe whether there is a rule in the data and summarize its linear equation. The results showed that different grades of beef had significant differences in RGB-HSV color model analysis, the linear relationship is, y(marbling standard)=0.018x( V value)+0.664 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathbf{R^{2}}=\boldsymbol{0.96533})$</tex>), with this data model, we checked our database for the marbling beef, the average accuracy is about 98.76, which also proved the effectiveness of the developed computer evaluation system and the feasibility on the method.

articleTitle: Analysis of Blockchain Electricity Trading System Based on the Bayesian Game
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The power industry is undergoing a rapid shift towards decarbonization, driven by the decreasing costs of low-carbon technologies and reduced competitive risks. While various power trading methodologies are emerging, current studies predominantly analyze transactions within a static game framework, lacking a comprehensive competitive analysis involving multiple participants. In real-world scenarios, trading parties engage in multiple rounds of negotiations to determine prices. To bridge this gap, we propose an innovative blockchain-based secure trading mechanism tailored for electricity quotas. This mechanism employs a bidding strategy designed for trading under conditions of incomplete information. Furthermore, we introduce a two-stage bargaining game model that utilizes the Bayesian game framework to calculate optimal bidding strategies for both buyers and sellers. This approach maximizes their revenues while ensuring the sustainability of the trading structure. Our analysis yields a Nash equilibrium solution that also satisfies Pareto optimality criteria, showcasing the theoretical and practical strengths of our proposed trading mechanism and model.

articleTitle: Improving CNN Model for Residential Building Image Classification: Enhancing Parameter Estimation Accuracy Through Transfer Learning and Reducing Model Complexity with MobileNet
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the widespread application of deep learning and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN) in image classification, how to effectively improve model performance and reduce its complexity has become a significant research direction. This study presents an improved CNN model for residential building image classification, which incorporates transfer learning and the MobileNet architecture. Through transfer learning, we effectively enhance parameter estimation accuracy, and by adopting the MobileNet architecture, we reduce the computational complexity and size of the model. Experimental results demonstrate that this approach achieves superior performance on the Cultural Heritage Apps dataset, verifying its efficacy in residential building image classification.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Underwater Embedded Robotic Platform Based on the ROS System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This research aims to enhance the navigational efficiency and safety of underwater robots, particularly in the context of complex and variable aquatic environments. Underwater robots are assuming an increasingly significant role in oceanic exploration, resource prospecting, and rescue missions. Nonetheless, their path planning algorithms continue to grapple with the challenges presented by uncertainty and dynamic obstacles. This study commences with an analysis of the current limitations inherent to global and local path planning approaches and proceeds to employ the Rapidly-exploring Random Tree (RRT) algorithm and the Dynamic Window Approach (DWA) to surmount these hurdles. The designed path planning system offers a more reliable and efficient navigational solution for underwater robots, holding substantial practical value and broad application prospects.

articleTitle: Research and Design of a Deep Learning-Based Free Trade Zone Data Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This study aims to design and implement a deep learning-based data analysis system for free trade zones. In the context of accelerated globalization and economic integration, data analysis of free trade zones is crucial for optimizing trade processes and enhancing economic efficiency. Traditional data analysis methods are somewhat inadequate in handling the high dimensionality, large scale, and complexity of free trade zone data. This research utilizes deep learning technology, particularly Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) networks, to process and analyze vast quantities of data from free trade zones, providing more profound insights. The study begins by reviewing the fundamentals of deep learning, followed by an analysis of its applicability and advantages in processing data from free trade zones. Through practical application cases, the study demonstrates the system's effectiveness in data preprocessing, model training, and result analysis. This system not only improves the efficiency of data processing but also provides more scientific bases for decision-making for policymakers and businesses, thereby promoting high-quality economic development.

articleTitle: Weather Avoidance Field Establishment Algorithm Based on Fuzzy Theory
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Severe weather poses a serious threat to flight safety. It is a great significance to establish the weather avoidance field accurately for ensuring flight safety and optimizing air traffic flow. In this paper, we propose a weather avoidance field establishment algorithm based on fuzzy theory. Based on the two important characteristics of weather system intensity and the degree of air traffic affected by weather, the algorithm adopts the weather weight function to describe the continuous positive correlation between weather influence degree and weather system intensity, and optimizes the distance correlation coefficient function by considering the change of affected area scope caused by the difference of weather system intensity. Thus, a weather avoidance field model is established to convert weather information into airspace constraints. Some straight results show that the model proposed in this paper can establish the weather avoidance field scientifically and reasonably.

articleTitle: Soccer Match Prediction based on Big Data Mining and Multimodal Features
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The sports industry ushered in new development and opportunities in the context of the big data era, especially the big data mining in the sports industry provides technical support for industrial iteration, promotes the innovative development of the sports industry, and accelerates the process of sports industry technology. As a popular sport in the field of soccer, it has received extensive attention from domestic and foreign fans, while data analysis and data mining in the field of soccer are also developing rapidly. Soccer game prediction is due to its many influencing factors, and there are diversity, uncertainty, ambiguity and other problems among the factors. At present, there are various ways to analyze soccer match prediction, and the rating system is not uniform, such as odds judgment, blind guessing based on historical experience, and it is not yet possible to quantify the internal relationship between features according to a set of uniform data mining process. Therefore, this paper proposes a multimodal feature extraction network based on deep learning, which can effectively extract a fusion of low-dimensional feature representations from many different modal features provided in the raw data of soccer matches. Finally, on the basis of solving the unidimensional prediction problem through traditional machine learning models and integration models, an improved Stacking integration model oriented to multidimensional features is innovatively proposed, and ultimately achieves the goal of improving the prediction accuracy and stability of soccer matches.

articleTitle: Urban Carbon Emission Prediction Method Based on Segmented Industry Terminal Energy Consumption
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: China has a large amount of carbon emissions, with urban carbon emissions occupying an important position. The role of cities in achieving the dual carbon goals is crucial. In the process of sustained and rapid development, cities face significant pressure and challenges in achieving carbon peak and carbon neutrality in the face of short time, weak foundation, and heavy tasks. In order to solve the problems of lack of quantification of urban carbon emission reduction effects and low accuracy of urban level carbon emission simulation, this study conducted a feasible prediction method for urban carbon emissions based on segmented industry terminal energy consumption prediction. Taking Beijing as an example, data sources were imported to obtain carbon emission prediction data for Beijing.

articleTitle: Research on Information System Cloud Computing Scheduling Method Based on Swarm Intelligence Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the advancement of cloud computing technology, research on cloud computing task scheduling has become a hot topic. This paper mainly studies the cloud computing scheduling method of information systems based on swarm intelligence algorithm, including cloud computing scheduling model based on particle swarm optimization(PSO), improved Invasive Tumor Growth Optimization(ITGO) model structure, and multi-objective cloud computing task scheduling based on improved artificial bee colony algorithm. This paper concludes that by introducing multi-objective optimization terms, replacing multi-objective optimization terms with fitness functions, initializing tumor cell set functions, and improving search strategies and selection strategies, the efficiency and quality of cloud computing task scheduling can be improved. In order to realize the optimal utilization of cloud computing resources and meet the needs of users.

articleTitle: Research and Design of an Advertisement Deployment Device Based on Multi-Sensor Fusion and Recommendation Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this study, we introduce an advanced design for an advertisement deployment device, distinguished by its utilization of multi-sensor data fusion techniques coupled with an LSTM-based recommendation system algorithm. This apparatus is adept at receiving and processing real-time user behavior and environmental data from an array of sensors. Through meticulous data preprocessing, feature extraction, and LSTM recommendation strategies, we can dynamically deliver advertisements that closely align with a user's behavior and environment. In essence, this design not only optimizes the precision of advertisement deployment but also enhances personalized user interaction experiences, offering significant academic and practical value.

articleTitle: Effect of Downhole Medium Conductivity on Active Magnetic Ranging Technique for Relief Wells
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Active magnetic ranging is the most effective technique for directing relief wells to intercept target wells. Based on the principle of active magnetic ranging for relief wells, the effects of the conductivity of the formation, casing, cement ring, and drilling fluid on the active magnetic ranging technique were investigated by experimental and numerical methods. Numerical results show that the conductivity of the formation, casing, cement ring, and drilling fluid all affect the magnetic field distribution around the casing; the 0.1S/m formation, higher conductivity casing, and cement ring can cause a stronger magnetic field to be stimulated around the casing; and it is desirable to use water-based drilling fluids for the ranging operation, but their conductivity should not be too high either; moreover, the distance from the probe tube to the electrode is appropriately optimized according to the different conductivity of the downhole medium, which is more beneficial to magnetic ranging. The results of this research are instructive for both relief well magnetic ranging operations and tool improvement.

articleTitle: Comprehensive Evaluation Model of College English Teaching Quality Based on Improved Deep Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The teaching level of college English teachers not only has a strong impact on the students' English learning but also determines the quality of English teaching. At present, many colleges are paying increasing attention to the evaluation of the teaching quality. The development of artificial intelligence has provided a way for colleges to conduct comprehensive scientific evaluation of the teaching quality. This study improves the deep neural network and proposes a new deep recurrent neural network algorithm. Furthermore, the improved sparrow search algorithm is introduced into deep recurrent neural network. Finally, a model is established to comprehensively evaluate college English teaching quality on the basis of the improved deep recurrent neural network. This model can not only fully extract and retain the valuable features in the data but also improve the evaluation performance. In addition, it can automatically optimize the number of neurons in the hidden layer of the model and eventually achieve accurate evaluation of college English teaching quality.

articleTitle: Design of Electronic Seals Based on the Internet of Things
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: To protect the security of public property, universities often use seals on important areas such as offices and laboratories during winter and summer breaks. Traditional paper seals are not only prone to falling off but can also be easily tampered with, making it difficult to identify the “culprits.” This results in ineffective sealing, high operational costs, and low efficiency. This paper proposes an IoT-based electronic seal control system, primarily composed of an STM32F103C8T6 microcontroller, passive infrared sensor, AT24C02 memory, relay, matrix keypad, 0.96-inch OLED display, ESP8266 WIFI module, and an alarm module. This design starts by collecting sensor data at the front end, promptly and accurately detecting the conditions around the seal and displaying them. Next, it uses IoT for wireless data transmission, followed by uploading the data to a computer backend. Personnel can control the seal through a PC or mobile app. The design also allows for dynamic password setting, enabling the electronic seal to be opened promptly in emergencies. Additionally, it can automatically open the electronic seal within predefined time periods. The use of electronic seals will be a valuable exploration for modernizing, informatizing, and smartifying campus construction in universities. This design can provide convenience for sealing office spaces during holidays, isolating infectious patients in hospitals, law enforcement, logistics security, and other societal needs. It will also enhance the authority of execution and facilitate the smooth progress of various tasks.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Forecasting of Power Load and Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The system is based on deep learning technology and is designed to accurately predict future power system loads, providing power consumption recommendations and control guidance for managers and users. The system is mainly divided into the management end and the user end, and the management end monitors the situation of electricity users, finds safety problems, and realizes the control of external electricity consumption. The user terminal identifies the electrical devices in the home, analyzes the power consumption and provides intelligent power consumption suggestions, and can also query the power details and pay the electricity bill.

articleTitle: Research on Data Security Technology Based on Homomorphic Encryption in Cloud Computing Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the development of cloud computing, data security issues have become increasingly prominent. As an encryption method that can perform calculations in the ciphertext domain, homomorphic encryption technology provides an effective solution for data security in a cloud computing environment. Data security technology based on homomorphic encryption is the main subject of this paper. First, the classification and characteristics of homomorphic encryption technology are introduced, as well as security analysis methods, and then a data security system based on fully homomorphic encryption is designed, including data acquisition and preprocessing modules. Then, the data analysis module adopts a model structure based on a neural network and provides the model training and parameter optimization process. Finally, experiments were conducted based on real data sets to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the system, and the system was evaluated from the aspects of accuracy, time overhead, and storage overhead. This paper concludes that homomorphic encryption technology can guarantee data privacy and integrity in a cloud computing environment while also improving computing efficiency and scalability.

articleTitle: Research on Financial and Accounting Risk Monitoring System Based on Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes a financial risk control system based on cloud computing. Firstly, this paper assembles the high-precision chip to the computer host. This lays the foundation for the design of the device. The calculation method of financial risk management system based on SVM is proposed. Establish a system connection for system performance testing. Under the same data capacity and experimental platform, the computing power of this system is better than the original one.

articleTitle: Human Body Movement Posture Monitoring and Recognition Based on KNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Traditional human movement posture monitoring and recognition methods use rule-based methods, but in complex scenes and situations with large posture changes, their accuracy and recall rates pose great challenges. This paper proposes a human movement posture monitoring and recognition method based on the K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) algorithm. This paper constructed a training data set containing rich posture information, and performed data preprocessing and feature extraction. Then this article calculates the distance between the posture sample to be classified and each sample in the training set, selects K nearest neighbor samples, and performs voting or weighted voting based on the labels of the nearest neighbor samples to determine the posture label of the sample to be classified. Experimental results show that the accuracy of this algorithm remains at a high level of 89%-97%. Compared with traditional methods, this method has achieved significant improvements in accuracy and recall.

articleTitle: Design and Application of CEMS-Based Measurement Equipment for Carbon Dioxide Emissions from Stationary Sources
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: On July 16, 2021, the national carbon emissions trading market will open, and in order to ensure the efficient operation of the carbon market trading mechanism, it is necessary to provide accurate carbon dioxide emissions data. At present, the mainstream methods of monitoring carbon emissions in the international are divided into accounting method and measurement method. The accounting method used by the mainstream in China has many problems such as human interference, low accuracy, large errors, low efficiency of data collection methods and serious time lag. With the development of measurement technology, the use of measurement method can provide more accurate carbon dioxide emission data, which can avoid the above problems of emission factor method and provide more accurate data for carbon market trading. This thesis proposes the design and application of CEMS-based measurement equipment for carbon dioxide emissions from stationary sources. It analyzes the current emission detection methods for stationary sources, conducts in-depth research on the overall architecture, composition structure, calculation method and other aspects, and designs the measurement equipment for stationary source carbon dioxide emissions to realize the transformation of carbon emissions from accounting to measurement, and to better serve the realization of the national “dual-carbon” goal.

articleTitle: Information Recommendation of English Oral Teaching Resource Library Based on Collaborative Filtering and Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to improve the sharing and real-time access scheduling capabilities of English oral teaching resource library information, a collaborative filtering and support vector machine based English oral teaching resource library information recommendation model is proposed. Using the keyword graph model and text semantic feature detection method to construct an information allocation network structure model for English oral teaching resource library, using collaborative filtering method to achieve keyword feature detection and interference information filtering for English oral teaching resources, and combining support machine classification recognition method to extract semantic keywords from text pairs, Introducing syntax parsing tree and pre trained language model to establish semantic information tree learning in the information recommendation process of English oral teaching resource library, constructing a text graph model based on extracted keywords, fully utilizing the semantic information tree of the text to pair the recommendation information between learning nodes and neighboring nodes, and inputting the generated text sequence into the recommendation sequence vector table, Combining collaborative filtering method and support vector machine algorithm to achieve information recommendation for English oral teaching resource library. The simulation results show that this method has good feature matching ability for recommending information in the English oral teaching resource library, with an Fl of 87.3 % on datasets such as CNSE. It has strong filtering ability for mixed information in the context of English oral resources, and improves the ability to accurately recommend information.

articleTitle: Pin Design Based on Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Since the birth of artificial intelligence technology in the last century, many computational methods have emerged to solve real-world problems for people, and it has been deeply integrated with various industries. For example, in the field of mechanical design, design parameters are often encountered. In order to help determine the optimal values of these design parameters, this paper proposes a pin design method based on genetic algorithm. In the first stage of this method, a mathematical model is constructed, including determining the design requirements, objective expressions, optimization variables (pin diameter d and pin length I), and limiting conditions of the pin, It's theoretical basis is knowledge of material mechanics, mechanical principles, and design related machinery; The second stage is to set various operating parameters in the genetic algorithm. After 2000 iterations, the fitness (objective expression) in the genetic algorithm has achieved the optimal solution. The design results are pin diameter d=4.054260630211105 cm, pin length 1=8.000000014901161 cm, and pin mass m=805.55982715964 g. Through the above analysis, this method can be widely promoted and applied in mechanical design.

articleTitle: Design of Commutator Cylindrical Foreign Object Detection System Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In the automatic production line of a motor, after the commutator has been turned and other processes, there may be copper chips and other foreign objects falling into the insulation slot to affect the performance of the motor. This paper adopts machine vision technology to automatically detect foreign objects in the commutator insulation slot and designs a commutator column surface foreign object detection system based on the improved YOLOv5. The composite illumination design with multiple light source combinations is used on the illumination system to collect pictures with obvious features in the insulation slot. The detection algorithm uses a PP-LCNet lightweight network to replace the backbone structure in the YOLOv5 network, introduces the SE module at the end of the network, and replaces the Relu activation function with the H-Swish activation function to speed up the detection speed. The experimental results show that the improved YOLOv5 algorithm reduces 54 misjudgments of qualified products per day compared with the traditional image recognition algorithm, and the correct recognition rate reaches 97.54%; the single inspection time is reduced by 66.29% compared with the YOLOv5 algorithm, which meets the accuracy and speed requirements of realtime inspection in automated production.

articleTitle: Dynamic Construction Method of Container Clusters for Highly Mobile Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In the context of the overall industry's digital transformation, Edge Computing technology continues to make significant advancements. In edge environments, there is a plethora of computing and processing devices used for constructing various types of information systems. However, these devices exhibit disparities in software and hardware resources, and their performance can vary greatly, with some being notably subpar. Terminal devices, in particular, face severe limitations in computing, storage, and network resources, which hinder the integration and deployment of functional services in various regions. To offer a greater variety of high-quality services to various endpoint devices, it is possible to construct clusters using the server resources available in edge environments to provide cloud services. Nevertheless, there is currently a lack of a dynamic construction method for container clusters under highly mobile conditions in edge environments. In response to the short-comings of existing technologies, this paper presents a dynamic construction method for container clusters tailored to highly mobile environments in edge computing. This method aims to address the challenges of organizing a self-adaptive construction environment for container clusters that can operate effectively under high-mobility conditions in edge application scenarios.

articleTitle: A Description Model of Dunhuang Murals Based on Multi-Scale and Multi-Level Aggregation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The study and preservation of Dunhuang murals is a major archaeological endeavor. With advances in computer technology and artificial intelligence, the use of deep learning techniques to further understand the context of Dunhuang murals and automatically generate descriptions with historical archaeological and cultural significance can help aid in the study of historical documents, inscriptions on Dunhuang murals, and the broader historical context to understand the significance of the murals, as well as the cultural and religious practices of the time. In addition, this work can assist in interpreting archaeological data, summarizing findings, and developing hypotheses about the creation and cultural significance of Dunhuang murals. This paper proposes an image description generation method that combines multi-scale and multi-level aggregation. AC-PPM-ResNet is adopted as the encoder to improve the utilization of image spatial information through AC block module, and the PPM module is used to obtain the multi-scale contextual information of the image, which provides the decoder with a feature representation of rich semantic information in generating the text description. In the decoding stage, the Transformer decoder embedded with LSTM as an aggregator is designed to fully utilize the multi-scale semantic spatial information obtained in the encoding stage, so that the model can fully take into account the information at different levels of the sentence, improve the accuracy of the description generation, and effectively solve the problems of insufficient performance of the text generation model and the loss of information. The experimental results on Dunhuang mural dataset show that the model proposed in this paper has better image description ability and certain generalization ability, the evaluation metrics outperform the other models.

articleTitle: Unmanned Helicopter Inspection Efficiency Evaluation for Forest Fire
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Establishing an Evaluation Framework for the Efficiency of Unmanned Helicopter Inspection in Forest Fires to promote the comprehensive application of unmanned helicopter inspections. Considering the influencing factors of unmanned helicopter inspections, a hierarchical evaluation indicator system is constructed, consisting of 4 primary indicators, 8 secondary indicators, and 17 tertiary indicators. The combination weighting method based on game theory is employed to determine the optimal combination weights for each indicator. Cloud models are applied to build technical and efficiency evaluation models for unmanned helicopter inspections. The effectiveness of the evaluation model is validated in the Qilian Mountains forest, demonstrating its objectivity and comprehensiveness. This model fills a gap in the evaluation of unmanned helicopter inspection efficiency for forest fires, providing valuable references for practical forest fire prevention and inspection strategies.

articleTitle: Aviation Conflict Mediation Model Based on Dynamic Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the increasing demand of air transportation, various types of aircrafts and transport planes often need to be deployed at the same time and space, which leads to the contradiction between the surge of air demand and the limited airspace resources. This paper relies on the improved dynamic particle optimization algorithm to establish a relief model for regulating the contradiction of airspace demand of various aircrafts, and experimentally verifies the feasibility and advantages of the model, and simulates the mediation of hundreds of conflicting airspace demands. The model can achieve global optimization between small fitness differences, and the optimization of the scheme can be achieved with a very small number of iterations. It provides a referable solution for problems with multiple local optimal solutions and complex nonlinear problems.

articleTitle: Research on Contextual Segmentation Technique of ChatGPT
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this paper, a convolution memory-based ChatGPT associative context segmentation model is established. First, this paper uses the crude data inference method to obtain the context-based lexical vector Word2Vec. By combining it with Fast Text lexical vectors, the implicit degree of feature vectors is improved. The relevance probability of ambiguous ChatGPT words is estimated, and the shortcomings of existing segmentation methods are solved based on the idea of maximum probability statistics. The segmentation methods of cross-type ambiguity, overlapping type ambiguity, combined type ambiguity and mixed type ambiguity are studied. Eliminating cross-type and combination-type ambiguity on ChatGPT semantic web. A coding method based on field is proposed, which can effectively reduce the dimension of field.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Web Crawler System Based on Python Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Extracting effective information from massive data and mining potentially valuable relationships has become a hot topic in the current research field. Web crawler has the function of automatically grasping web page information, and can automatically obtain the content of the accessed page. Through analysis, users can quickly obtain the information they need. Web crawler is an effective means to extract effective information from massive data. In view of the limitations of open web crawlers such as Laebin, Nutch and Heritrix, this paper studies web crawlers based on Python technology, including Requests, Scrapy and Selenium. The realization of three kinds of web crawler is studied, and the simulation experiment and result analysis are carried out. The results show that Scrapy technology is recommended for practical application if there is no special requirement. Because Scrapy supports asynchronous crawling, concurrency is flexible, supports crawling on different urls, and is easy to use for simple crawling tasks.

articleTitle: Power dispatch control center log management platform based on multi-dimensional data mining
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of complex data application management process and low data processing efficiency in the power dispatch control center, a power dispatch control center log management platform based on multi-dimensional data mining is proposed. First, the process of generating multi-dimensional data for power dispatching is analyzed, and the main problems of the data are analyzed. The key technologies of data mining for the platform application proposed in this article are explained. The gray correlation analysis of data and the support vector machine model are discussed. The basic process of information data mining in the log management platform is given. The corresponding system architecture is proposed, the platform interface specifications are explained, and the platform security control measures are discussed. Scenario analysis was conducted on functions such as linkage between dispatch logs and other businesses, graphical display, comprehensive query, and shift handover.

articleTitle: Design of an Automobile Status Monitoring Platform Based on Multi-Sensor Data Fusion
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the swift progression of the automotive industry, real-time monitoring of vehicular status has become increasingly paramount. Existing monitoring methodologies are, however, constrained by their inherent limitations. This paper presents an automobile status monitoring platform rooted in multi-sensor data fusion. Data processing and analysis are executed through a synergistic approach, employing the LSTM model combined with a rule engine. The research discerns that this methodology proficiently extracts pertinent information from abundant sensor data, monitoring the automobile's operational state and potential issues both real-time and with precision. This investigation proffers robust backing for vehicular health management and fault prognosis, demonstrating significant practical relevance.

articleTitle: Research of Footwear Virtual Simulation Design Laboratory Based on Computer Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper studies the application of multi-modal modeling method in the design and development of sneakers samples based on two-dimensional digital collaborative design and three-dimensional digital simulation. The multi-body system is modeled by using AD-AMS. A walking simulation system based on neural network is proposed, and the ILC walking simulation system is realized by combining it with MA TLAB. The purpose of this paper is to explore the comfort of shoes in the state of exercise. Simulation analysis shows that the mathematical model is reasonable and feasible, and lays a theoretical basis for the development of prototype.

articleTitle: Load Capacity Assessment and Early Warning Technology Based on Big Data Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes a transient stability prediction and preventive control system for power systems. Firstly, the functional framework and software module of the system are introduced. Then the transient load of the distribution system is calculated and the data characteristics based on BP neural network are obtained. Using the data overflow control method, the transient load threshold is determined, and the monitoring and warning level is divided. It is found that the transient load monitoring of distribution network based on abnormal data flow established in this project has achieved good results in improving monitoring accuracy and reducing monitoring error rate.

articleTitle: Research on Spring Defect Detection System of High-Voltage Circuit Breaker in Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In view of the problems existing in the current real-time monitoring system of the tension spring pressure of the tension spring operating mechanism of the circuit breaker, a real-time monitoring system of the tension spring pressure of the tension spring operating mechanism is proposed. It uses an electronic push rod equipped with a hydraulic elastic device to press the hydraulic valve. When the electronic push rod moves to a certain position, the hydraulic elastic device will generate pressure, thereby releasing the stored spring energy. The hydraulic device can be activated by the accumulator motor to store energy when the power pole is restarted. By adjusting the switching value, the switching value reaches the maximum value.

articleTitle: Study on Device of Extracting Photoplethysmography Signals from the Human Body
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The photoplethysmography signal is a composite signal containing various physiological parameters of the human body. Its spectrum has 5 different frequency components in (0.007-1.5) Hz, corresponding to the human body's respiration, blood pressure, body temperature control, autonomic nervous system, and cardiac synchronous pulse. The high-accuracy extraction of the photoplethysmography is of great significance for home health monitoring and intensive care. Aiming at the problem that the current photoplethysmography signal extraction equipment is cumbersome and expensive, this paper proposes an effective method to extract photoplethysmography (PPG) from human fingertips. The hardware system mainly includes an STM32 main Control chip module, photoelectric volume pulse wave extraction module, power circuit module, SD card storage module, and LCD module, which can realize real-time display and storage of human PPG signals and combine the stored PPG signals with the simultaneous PPG extracted by the multi-parameter monitor. The signals are analyzed and compared on the MATLAB platform, and the results show that the photoplethysmographic rate accuracy rates are above 95%, and the correlation coefficients in the AR power spectrum are all above 90%. The hardware system device is superior in extracting the photoplethysmography signal.

articleTitle: Research on the Product Automatic Pricing Model Based on Grey Relation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this study, firstly, considering the close relationship between cost-plus pricing and cost-plus markup rate, as well as the known wholesale and retail prices of vegetable categories, we shifted the focus of analysis to the “relationship between sales volume of various vegetable categories and cost-plus markup rate.” Through grey relational analysis, we found that six vegetable categories exhibited a correlation coefficient exceeding 0.8, indicating a significant impact of cost-plus pricing on sales volume. Subsequently, utilizing ARIMA time series analysis, we successfully forecasted the sales volume and prices of foliage vegetables for the upcoming week. This aids supermarkets in better planning their supply chains and pricing strategies. Lastly, we addressed question three by conducting data processing and calculating crucial indicators such as average sales volume and unit profit for each individual product.
