By establishing an optimization model with the objective of “maximizing revenue” and “minimum display quantity” as a constraint, we determined the number and quantity of products that the supermarket should order. This decision was based on a balance between historical data and the minimum display quantity requirement to achieve maximum revenue. In summary, this study provides robust support for the sales strategy and supply chain management of supermarkets. It assists in gaining a deeper understanding of the impact of cost-plus pricing on sales, forecasting future sales trends, and maximizing revenue. This holds significant implications for enhancing operational efficiency.

articleTitle: Research on GISC Image Reconstruction Algorithm Based on Area Array CCD Image Sensor
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Ghost imaging sparsity constraints (GISC) spectral camera can acquire both spatial and spectral information of surface features, and has significant application prospects in the field of satellite remote sensing. This article uses a planar CCD image sensor for photoelectric detection, and then reconstructs multispectral images through image reconstruction algorithms. The article describes the theoretical foundation, related technologies, and image reconstruction algorithms of GISC. Reconstruct the three-dimensional spectral image of the target through single exposure detection of the speckle field and pre calibrated measurement matrix. The research results have advantages such as high energy utilization rate, fast information acquisition efficiency, and the ability to obtain three-dimensional data information with a single exposure.

articleTitle: Categorizing Pain Intensity Through Facial Recognition Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Overcrowding in Emergency Departments (ED) is multiplying each year, influencing both the staff and patients and causing a rise in the number of patients in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU). Patients in the ICU require long term observation and extensive monitoring, and with the gap in the ratio of patients to staff, the issue of shortages of staff arises, along with high burnout rates among staff. Though many have tried to undertake this issue, few have succeeded. This paper proposes a deep learning model that aims to reduce the number of ICU and ED patients by categorizing pain intensity levels on a scale of 1–5 in addition to personal use, achieving its goals where no pain achieved a final accuracy of 59.26%, mild pain a final accuracy of 72.73%, moderate pain a final accuracy of 70.34%, severe pain a final accuracy of 64.80%, and very severe pain a final accuracy of 60.69%.

articleTitle: Optimizing Stroke Prediction in Machine Learning by Addressing Data Imbalance
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Brain strokes, responsible for about 11% of global deaths annually according to the World Health Organization, pose significant health challenges. Machine learning aids in early stroke risk prediction and personalized assessment, optimizing medical resource allocation. However, the low frequency of stroke cases in datasets poses challenges for accurate stroke prediction by these models. Addressing this data imbalance is key for effective prediction. This article focuses on: (i) analyzing machine learning outcomes on imbalanced stroke dataset; (ii) comparing methods to address data imbalances; and (iii) using Automated Machine Learning (AutoML) techniques to achieve high accuracy while realistically identifying stroke incidents. The results demonstrate that the application of Random Under Sampling (RUS) was instrumental in identifying the top-performing model, which showed superior performance in stroke prediction.

articleTitle: Research on Emergency Mobilization of Logistics Parcels Based on LSTM Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: At present, the rapid development of national logistics, how to achieve under the conditions of limited cost to reduce the impact of logistics site deactivation on the logistics network, to ensure the normal operation of the logistics network has become a hot topic. This paper predicts the future parcel freight volume based on the historical data of logistics parcels. First, the data are preprocessed and the time series are decomposed based on the additive model. The effects of seasonal components and trend components of the time series are removed by first-order differencing. Here the freight volume is predicted by the LSTM model. Finally, considering the unexpected events, the number of routes with changes in cargo volume due to the shutdown of DC5, the volume of cargo that cannot flow normally, and the network load are analyzed.

articleTitle: Research on Technical Loss Reduction Aided Decision System Based on Multi-Source Big Data
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: A real-time evaluation of network loss and an auxiliary decision-making method for energy saving and consumption reduction based on power market is proposed. The on-line calculation of sub-line, sub-circuit, sub-voltage and sub-zone of network loss in each province is realized. Power flow method, root mean square method, power collection, state estimation, and multi-dimensional power integration method are used to verify. By analyzing the network structure, the change of power network structure and operation mode is tracked in real time, and the information of data collection nodes in power system is matched with it. This reduces the manual maintenance effort. The practical application shows that the dynamic change of line loss can be mastered effectively by using this software. At the same time, it can guide the economic operation and management of power grid.

articleTitle: Research on Power System Transformation and Control Technology Based on New Power Electronic Devices
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: As we enter the new era, power system transformation and control technology have entered a high-quality development stage. We are committed to the idea of a power system with power electronic devices as the core, and we propose power system transformation and control to meet the needs of power systems for power quality and stability. Based on the test platform of SiC MOSFET and the fuzzy PID method, we construct the theoretical analysis framework of power system transformation and control according to the internal logic of power system transformation and control and explain the power system development mechanism generated by the power system transformation mechanism and control mechanism with the participation of SiC MOSFET and fuzzy PID. In addition, efforts have been made to explore the possibility of moving towards high-quality development goals from the structural characteristics and experimental results of power systems. The purpose of power system transformation and control is to improve power quality and stability that meet the expected standards for power systems and to continuously improve the level of power system transformation and control, improving user satisfaction. Therefore, we take a series of measures, including enhancing current and temperature control based on the structural characteristics of SiC MOSFETs, building interaction and feedback between SiC MOSFET and fuzzy PID, and establishing the evaluation system of SiC MOSFET and fuzzy PID to promote the development of power system and meet energy demand.

articleTitle: A Study on Train Schedule Planning Based on Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Metro as the main carrier of urban transportation, how to organize traffic to better ease the contradiction between travel demand and supply has become an urgent problem. At present, the common mode of subway operation is the large and small crossing mode, and one of the core problems is the optimization of train schedule. In this paper, the passenger flow data from 6:00 to 7:00 is supplemented, and the multi-objective planning model is established after the unification of the scale. And using the ideal point method, the multi-objective problem into a single two optimization problems, and then through the simulated annealing algorithm to determine the optimal solution of each index. And then use Matlab software to find out that the running interval of large intersection is 1 station-30 stations, the running mileage is 40.168km, and the number of parallel columns is 14; the running interval of small intersection is 8 stations-30 stations, the running mileage is 30.809km, and the number of parallel columns is 14.

articleTitle: Predicting Body Mass Index Level Based on Decision Tree
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the development of the times and the promotion and popularization of healthy lifestyles, people pay more and more attention to their own health, such as basic health attributes such as height and weight. For these two attributes, BMI (Body Mass Index) can be used to measure. In order to help people analyze and predict BMI grades, this paper proposes a BMI grade prediction scheme based on machine learning, first collect and prepare local personal body data; then preprocess this batch of data, and process the data into only features and label data; then perform basic data analysis, mainly using visual charts to display; and then follow the model training process of machine learning (decision tree), through training, the final model is obtained on the training set, verification set, and test set respectively. The prediction scores of 1.0000, 0.9893, and 0.9932; finally, save the model locally and use the model to predict new sample data, which has achieved relatively good prediction results, and hopes to provide some solutions to problems when predicting BMI grades.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Relationship Between COVID-19 and Diet Based on Machine Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this paper, the data set of food and nutrition intake from the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) and COVID-19 case counts from the World Health Organization (WHO) are used to analyze the relationship between diet and COVID-19 infections in different countries. Different machine learning algorithms, like regression, clustering, and classification, are used to process and analyze the data set. In addition, an improved random forest method for feature selection is proposed. This paper has studied the relationship between food intake and obesity or undernourished, the association between the amount of food consumed and the amount of fat, protein, and calories consumed through that food, and the impact on the confirmed, deaths and recovery rate of COVID-19. The purpose is trying to find some foods that can prevent or assist in the treatment of COVID-19, and achieve a non-pharmaceutical intervention for COVID-19 through a healthy diet.

articleTitle: Design of the Parking Lot Intelligent Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The design of intelligent parking management system aims to improve the efficiency and accuracy of parking management and provide better parking services for car owners. The system uses Raspberry PI as the main hardware platform to automate management and vehicle identification technology. Its main functions include automatic identification and recording of vehicle entry and exit, and real-time display of the remaining parking Spaces. In addition, the system can also realize remote monitoring and management through the Internet, to provide more convenient management.

articleTitle: Tourist Attraction Recommendation Based on Spark Cloud Computing Platform Algorithm Optimisation Study
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Nowadays, in the context of big data, online travel data is getting overloaded day by day, and the storage, calculation, analysis and management of data has become one of the urgent problems in the travel industry. In addition, the overload of tourism data also brings great information trouble to users and reduces their experience of tourism services. In order to solve the above problems, new platforms and suitable recommendation algorithms are urgently needed to provide users with better travel information screening and recommendation services.

articleTitle: PLC-Based Precision Control System Design and Realization of Electrical Equipment
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: As a programmable control technology for electrical equipment, PLC is a complex system integrating programming software, memory and related interfaces. Through accurate and reliable program programming, it improves the level and efficiency of automated control of electrical equipment, and can meet the requirements of low-cost, safe and accurate control. Due to the dynamic nature of the operating parameters of electrical equipment, it is not possible to accurately control and regulate the execution time of operations, thus affecting the efficiency and reliability of the system. Based on this, the model, hardware and software design scheme of the control system of electrical equipment based on PLC technology is proposed, and the reliability is tested and verified through practical applications, with a view to providing references for related scholars' research.

articleTitle: Application of the LDA-LSTM-Seq-BERT Model in Identifying Prime Core Patents
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The evolution of natural language processing technologies has facilitated the classification and recognition of patent texts. While a plethora of methodologies exists to achieve this aim, many still possess inherent limitations. This paper introduces a novel model, LDA-LSTM-Seq-BERT, amalgamating LDA, LSTM, and BERT, devised to enhance the quality of patent text classification and bolster recognition accuracy. Initially, an extensive array of patent text data was amassed from multiple patent databases, followed by meticulous preprocessing and label extraction. Subsequently, LDA was employed to perform thematic clustering on the patent classification label set, and further training was executed using LSTM. In Culmination, we procured a high-caliber technical patent recognition set, known as “bottleneck” technology. This investigation furnishes a groundbreaking and efficacious approach to patent classification and recognition.

articleTitle: Optimization of Multibeam Ocean Bathymetric Model Based on Ant Colony-Greedy Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: As the traditional single-beam bathymetry may lead to large errors due to the discontinuity in the direction of the survey line, multibeam bathymetry system has been widely used because it can improve the accuracy and coverage of radar measurements in complex environments, and how to improve the accuracy and precision of the measurement results has become an important issue in the process of bathymetry. Therefore, this paper establishes and solves the mathematical model of multibeam bathymetry coverage width under single survey line and rectangular sea area, and at the same time, for the problem of how to make multibeam bathymetry cover all the sea area to be surveyed while maintaining the appropriate coverage, the optimization models based on ant colony algorithm and greedy algorithm are established respectively to realize the solution for the length of the shortest group of survey lines.

articleTitle: On-Line Detection System of Rain and Sewage in Sponge City Based on Internet of Things and BP Neural Network Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The rain pollution detection system of sponge city based on Internet of Things is designed, which can be used for on-line remote detection of sponge city rain and sewage, and realize the over-limit alarm. A set of BP neural network is used, which can be used to forecast the rain pollution in sponge city, and analyze the matching between the water supply and water demand, including the matching of time, space, water quantity and water quality, it is helpful to identify the necessity and demand of urban rainwater resources control and utilization from both qualitative and quantitative aspects. Through the combination of Internet of things, cloud computing, big data and other information technology means, make the previously difficult to monitor the variables become easier to promote the construction of intelligent sponge city.

Author Keywords: Online detection of rain and sewage

articleTitle: Mining Technology of Big Data Trusted Sharing in Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In view of the low input and output efficiency of traditional supply chain sharing mining technology, a trusted sharing mining technology of supply chain big data based on improved data envelope analysis algorithm was proposed. The supply chain trust evaluation method based on improved DEA algorithm is adopted, and the evaluation results are stored in the form of data set. DEA algorithm is used to optimize the input and output efficiency of supply chain sharing, and genetic algorithm is combined to avoid the local optimal problem of DEA algorithm. The supply chain big data streaming method is adopted to process the data set data, and the data is provided to each subject in the shared information publishing layer with certification qualification to access and use, and the trusted sharing mining of supply chain big data is realized. The experimental results show that the technology has excellent big data sharing mining effect, can effectively adjust the supply chain input and output, and improve the overall performance of the supply chain.

articleTitle: A Study on Pricing and Replenishment of Vegetable Commodities Based on Goal Planning and Time Series Forecasting Models
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper mainly focuses on the automatic pricing and replenishment problem of superstore vegetable products to carry out in-depth research. Firstly, the sales trends of different vegetable categories are analyzed through data preprocessing and statistical tests; secondly, the sales volume and wholesale price are predicted by using XGBoost and LSTM models, and the results show that the accuracy of the models is high (R2>0.93); finally, a revenue maximization model based on the PSO algorithm is constructed, which successfully predicts the total revenue in the next seven days and confirms the model's robustness through sensitivity analysis. robustness of the model. In addition, the limitations of the model and the direction of future improvement are discussed.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Geographic System of Underground Cable Facilities Based on Digital Twin Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: A numerical simulation method of 3D power pipeline system based on 5D data was established. Firstly, hand-drawn modeling and parametric technology were used to 3D reconstruct the pipeline to obtain the virtual entity that can be quickly generated. The actual environment in the system is presented in a visual way. The operation status of pipeline is monitored and maintained in real time by intelligent scheduling method. The safety condition of pipeline is evaluated and forecasted to achieve the effective combination of virtual and real information. Finally, a simple and practical system prototype is completed. The preliminary results show the operation and safety management of the power plant.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Causes of Non-Characteristic Harmonics Problems for a Converter Station
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper analyzes and studies the problem of non-characteristic harmonics levels abnormally in AC power grid of the YN converter station in East China. Firstly, the basic situation of the converter station is introduced and an equivalent model is provided for harmonic analysis of the converter station in this paper. Then, based on on-site test data and trend correlation analysis, the harmonic analysis model of the converter station is simplified, and the reason for the harmonic voltage abnormally of the AC bus in the converter station is clarified. Finally, by analyzing the power flow distribution of harmonic in the outgoing lines of power grid for the converter station, the main harmonic sources of the converter station are identified, providing a basis for the governance of harmonic problems in the converter station.

articleTitle: Design of Intelligent Medical Care System Based on Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the development of technologies such as the Internet of Things and embedded technology, 4-2-1 families are facing the contradiction between work and pension. In the paper, Intelligent Medical care system has been designed based on cloud platform, which mainly uses STM32 as the core controller. The hardware part includes a heart rate sensor module, an infrared body temperature monitoring module, an intelligent security detection module, a communication module, Real-time detection of physiological state and home environment etc.. The test results show that the system can effectively record and analyze the physiology and activities of the elderly at home, which can effectively take care of the elderly and reduce unnecessary risks, while greatly reducing children's worries about the elderly and providing children with a harmonious life condition.

articleTitle: Prediction of Vegetable Price Index Based on Regression Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: No matter at home or abroad, people want to have a healthy diet, such as healthy vegetables. Therefore, it is necessary to pay attention to the change of vegetable price index. In order to help solve this problem, this paper puts forward a method of forecasting vegetable price index based on regression analysis. Firstly, this method obtains the historical data of vegetable price index; Then, the characteristics of HZSJ_ZSZ (fixed base price index), HZSJ_CHANGE (price change rate), HZSJ_VALUEHB (chain price index), HZSJ_VALUETB (year-on-year price index), HZSJ_CHANGETB (year-on-year price change rate) and HZSJ_CHANGEHB (chain price change rate) in this data set are analyzed visually. Then use regression analysis method to model and analyze; Finally, the model is used to predict the data of the test set. Through repeated training and testing, good prediction results have been achieved.

articleTitle: Research on Digital Creative Data Processing System Based on Computer Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes the design and construction method of mobile phone digital creative creation system based on machine learning. In this paper, its architecture, design and implementation are described in detail. The machine learning method based on gradient lifting regression tree is used to obtain the interaction between the communication of each process. Through the statistical analysis of the relevant data, the correlation degree of each digital creative creation is obtained. The analysis of experimental data. Further reduce the technical barriers of mobile terminal digital creativity, and improve the commercial content innovation and service efficiency of mobile terminal digital creativity.

articleTitle: Model and Experimental Study of Impedance Control System for Robot Grinding and Polishing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Grindingis an important processing procedure in the production process of workpiece, and industrial robots are widely used in the field of grinding and polishing workpiece by relying on its freedom and expansibility. However, since the fiber direction of the workpiece and the robot end grinding tool need to maintain a certain angle, and because of the error between actual surface profile and the model, it is difficult to ensure the constant grinding and polishing force during the robot operation, affecting the uniformity of the surface process. In this paper, a set of robot impedance control model with constant grinding force and high precision is designed based on simulation, and experimental research is carried out, which provides a foundation for the research of robot grinding flexible control system with workpiece model generating tool path.

articleTitle: A Novel Fault Diagnosis Method for Rolling Bearing Based on TVFEMD Energy Entropy and PFA-LSSVM Optimization Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The precision and effectiveness of diagnostic outcomes for rolling bearing faults are crucial for ensuring the reliability and safety of machinery. On the premise of this background, a time-varying filtering based empirical mode decomposition (TVFEMD) energy entropy and pathfinder algorithm (PFA) optimized least squares support vector machine (LSSVM) fault diagnosis method is proposed. Firstly, considering the significant fluctuations that vibration signals exhibit in complex operating conditions, TVFEMD is used to acquire several sets of IMFs. Secondly, to extract crucial information from IMF components that describes the state of the equipment, the energy entropy method can be served to construct the feature vectors that characterize essential fault information. Finally, based on the generated vectors and PFA-LSSVM, the fault classification can be implemented. Relevant experiments are systematically undertaken to elucidate the performance characteristics. The results conspicuously affirm the method's effectiveness and superiority in comparison of the existing approaches.

articleTitle: Design of Face Recognition System Based on Linux System and OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the continuous development of social informatization, computers and networks are increasingly penetrating into our lives. The traditional company attendance registration has become increasingly unsuitable for the progress and development of the times. In order to better solve this problem, this article is based on the Linux system and uses the OpenCV open-source library as the core to design face recognition systems in these environments. The hardware of this system takes the ARM board as the core, combines USB cameras and sensors to collect face images, uses QT as the human-computer interface, and uses Baidu AI Cloud database as the face collection database. At the same time, research was conducted on the design principles of facial recognition systems, with a focus on exploring technical issues such as feature extraction and facial recognition. The system can better improve the attendance system of dormitories or companies, and has great potential for application.

articleTitle: Research on Information Processing System Under Computer Artificial Intelligence Big Data Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this paper, a virtual view image post-processing method using background information is proposed. Firstly, a depth-based method is used to deal with overlapping between two images. Secondly, the artifacts of the left and right virtual view are located by the motion direction of the observation point, and the artifacts are eliminated by the background pixels in the supplementary view Angle. Then the background image is filled with holes and combined with the foreground image to form a virtual perspective image. The experimental results show that the peak signal noise of this method is 0.6357 dB better than that of the traditional method. Experiments show that the method proposed in this paper can improve the rendering effect significantly.

articleTitle: Function and Application Analysis of Integrated Power Dispatching Platform Based on Multi-Service Support
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to solve the needs of power dispatching business with the diversification of scenarios and upgrading of functions, the design of an integrated power dispatching platform based on multi-service support is proposed, focusing on analyzing its functions and applications. First, the division of power dispatching business was classified, and the supporting requirements for power dispatching business were put forward. The key technologies for power dispatch business support in real-time data access, business data fusion, spatial information modeling, etc. are explained. An integrated dispatching support platform was established, and the platform architecture, network structure and functional application scenarios were analyzed. The effectiveness of the proposed functions and applications was demonstrated, and the demonstration results showed that this article effectively improved the scheduling task data processing capacity with the support of multi-service data processing.

articleTitle: Investigation of Advanced Intelligent Computer-Assisted Systems for Fault Diagnosis and Control
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The fault diagnosis system of tunnel boring machine under PDCA fault cycle is studied based on multi-source information. The system includes three modules, namely intelligent selection plan generation, fuzzy comprehensive evaluation system of the plan and fuzzy multi-attribute decision-making model. Realize the selection of tunnel boring machine and the optimization of main parameters. The research results of this project will provide technical support for tunnel boring machine fault diagnosis. Finally, the fault diagnosis method was verified by taking an actual project as an example. Research shows that integrated diagnosis methods can effectively improve the effectiveness and accuracy of tunnel boring machine fault diagnosis, thereby effectively improving the efficiency of engineering construction.

articleTitle: A Safety Barrier Dome on the Pole for Insulation Protection of Workers Without Power Outages
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In view of the problem of relative lack of insulation protection above the workers in the current non-power outage operation of the distribution network, a design and installation method of a safety barrier dome on a pole is introduced. By limiting the vertical movement range of the workers on the pole, the safety barrier below, the scope of both activities of workers and the use of tools should always maintain a certain safe distance from the upper-level live objects, in order to ensure the safety of the operation and avoid the occurrence of electric shock casualties, in which workers accidentally touch the upper-level charged body. The safety barrier dome on this pole has good insulation performance. After being reinstalled, it is very strong with excellent wind resistance, which can meet the needs of most working scenarios.

articleTitle: Intelligent Decision Optimization for Industrial Supply Chain Based on Reinforcement Learning and Deep Q Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The management of industrial supply chains involves a series of complex decision-making processes, where the uncertainty of demand, supply, and inventory poses significant challenges. Understanding the essence of these challenges, this paper seeks to introduce an avant-garde approach to address them. At the heart of our proposal is the application of an intelligent decision optimization framework constructed on the foundational principles of reinforcement learning (RL). This approach, distinct from traditional methods, leverages the power of machine learning to guide decision-making, offering notable advantages in adaptability and precision.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Investment Strategies: Optimizing Portfolios Through Large-Scale Language Models and Innovative Leasing Structures
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The advent of ChatGPT technology in 2023, developed by OpenAI, has captivated global attention, highlighting its financial management and innovative leasing arrangement with Microsoft. This study delves into this leasing model, employing large-scale language models to forge advanced portfolio optimization algorithms centered around the artificial intelligence industry. The paper addresses the shift in financial practices, transitioning from traditional equity and debt purchases to more flexible and potentially lucrative arrangements, symbolizing a movement towards a more collaborative and forward-thinking investment paradigm. In this context, leasing, although a well-established concept in realms such as real estate and automotive, finds an unprecedented application in the technology sector, particularly in artificial intelligence. This innovative structure allows OpenAI to maintain operational autonomy while gaining financial and strategic support from tech giants like Microsoft, positioning OpenAI as a tenant, with the lease duration contingent on its profitability. This incentivizes OpenAI to maximize its profitability and prolong Microsoft's support, offering a risk-mitigated opportunity for Microsoft to benefit from advancements in AI without the liabilities of full ownership. This paper aims to create a novel customer experience and enhance risk management for investors by integrating Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques with traditional portfolio optimization methods. Portfolio optimization is a crucial aspect of investment strategy, involving the selection of an optimal asset mix to maximize returns and minimize risk. This research anticipates training large-scale language models on financial texts to analyze vast amounts of unstructured data from diverse sources, identifying trends, sentiments, and signals potentially overlooked by conventional methods. Integrating these algorithms into innovative quantitative investment strategies, the study seeks to provide tailored investment advice and services based on individual investor needs and preferences, leveraging AI to analyze historical data, offer independent investment recommendations, identify patterns and trends quantitatively, and implement proactive risk management strategies.

articleTitle: Research on a Statistical Model of Floating Photovoltaic Construction Progress Based on Target Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Compared to land-based housing construction, floating photovoltaic construction has the following characteristics: a large area, a long travel time, and the simultaneous construction of multiple surfaces. Recently, drone photography has become a popular method of counting construction workload. Therefore, to resolve the issues of densely packed pipe piles, bracket components, and other targets in captured images, small pixels, and difficulty in detection, in this paper, the YOLOv7 is improved to increase the algorithm's learning effect on dense small target features during training, as well as using the SAHI slicing method to improve accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of Computer Intelligent Sensing Technology in Seedling Transplanting System of Small Remote Control Biological Floating Island
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of less mechanical equipment and low efficiency of manual operation in the seedling transfer and cutting process of biological floating island technology, a small remote control seedling transplanting device of biological floating island was studied based on existing small hull equipment and rice transplanter. A combination of wireless remote control and sensing device is used to control the hull remotely, so that the stability control, speed control and steering control of the hull on the water surface can be achieved through remote operation. So that the planting mechanism can accurately transplanting seedlings into the corresponding hole position of the floating bed, and realize the accurate and efficient transplanting operation of biological floating island seedlings.

articleTitle: Building Green Monitoring System Based on Computer
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper studies a computer based building safety monitoring technology. The whole network includes: multiple camera equipment and multiple monitoring information nodes, all of which use wireless communication modules to connect with the monitoring center. In this paper, multiple camera equipment and monitoring data collection equipment will be used to form a wireless sensor network together with the wireless communication module, that is, the comprehensive monitoring of multiple monitoring points to conduct all-round and reliable building data monitoring from the perspective of building layout; Through the real-time monitoring of the construction activity video equipment near the building, the distance between the coordinate point of the video equipment closest to the building plane and the closest distance between the video equipment and the building plane is calculated, and the warning of the construction activity safety distance is realized by analyzing the construction activity safety distance; Through the real-time monitoring of the building structure parameters and the surrounding environment of the building, through the analysis of the monitored building structure parameters and the surrounding environment of the building, the safety warning of the engineering structure and the safety warning of the surrounding environment of the project are realized, and the comprehensive and reliable construction data monitoring is carried out on the type of monitoring data.

articleTitle: Design of a Free Trade Zone Data Management and Analysis Platform Based on Computer Machine Learning Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This study is dedicated to architecting a data management and analysis platform, integrating advanced computer technologies and machine learning algorithms. Traditional approaches often fall short in handling and analyzing vast data sets. Thus, this paper proposes an innovative solution: enhancing data processing efficiency and precision through machine learning technologies. The research thoroughly examines the application of machine learning in data management, including the selection of appropriate algorithms, effective model training and optimization, and their integration into a user-friendly platform. The platform's design aims to deliver more accurate data analysis, supporting informed decision-making.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Unmanned Supervisory Management Platform for Parking Lots Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This research aims to design an unmanned supervisory management platform for parking lots based on deep learning technology to address issues present in traditional parking management methods. By employing the YOLOv5 object detection algorithm and Deep Sort object tracking algorithm, this platform achieves efficient monitoring and multilayered analysis of vehicles within the parking lot. The analytical methods for recognition results encompass analysis of parking duration, traffic flow, abnormal events, and user behavior, providing decision-making foundations for parking lot management. The system's operational workflow design includes data acquisition, object detection and tracking, recognition result analysis, abnormal event detection and handling, as well as user interface display and data storage, ensuring the efficiency of intelligent management and monitoring.

articleTitle: Prediction Model of Car Ownership Based on PCA-Logistic Regression
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The prediction of vehicle ownership involves a nonlinear relationship with multiple variable inputs. This study employed a Logistic regression model to analyze variables based on eight indicators: total population, per capita GDP, gross product ratios of primary, secondary, and tertiary industries, per capita disposable income of urban residents, disposable income of rural residents, and urbanization level. These indicators served as the main input variables for predicting national civilian car ownership. The results demonstrated that the use of the Logistic regression model for forecastin yielded highly accurate data on civilian vehicle ownership. This data can serve as a valuable foundation for initiatives related to air pollution prevention, ecological environmental protection, and urban governance.

articleTitle: Prediction of COVID-19 Epidemic Based on Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Since the emergence of the COVID-19 epidemic, it has had a profound impact on people's activities. In order to grasp the changes of epidemic situation in COVID-19 in real time, this paper puts forward an analysis and prediction method of epidemic situation in COVID-19 based on ensemble learning. Firstly, the historical data of epidemic situation is captured from web. Then simply analyze the data; Then, the change trend is displayed by visual scatter diagram; Then, the ensemble learning algorithm is used to model and analyze the number of asymptomatic cases, confirmed cases, cured cases, dead cases, existing confirmed cases, local asymptomatic cases and suspected cases, and better model parameters are obtained. Finally, the trained model is used to predict the estimated value of new data. After many tests, this method can meet the requirements of prediction and provide support for epidemic analysis and prediction.

articleTitle: The Design of Tractor CAN Communication Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to meet the demand for real-time information sharing among controllers of heavy-duty tractors, a CAN bus communication network for the entire machine was designed. This network includes nodes such as vehicle control unit, engine controller, gearbox controller, electronic control lifting controller, precision operation controller, and instruments. This article mainly designs the tractor CAN network and completes the development of the topology structure of the tractor CAN network. The entire machine controller and various component controllers of the tractor are designed based on the transmission protocol of SAE J1939. CANoe software is used to model and simulate the tractor CAN network. The simulation results show that the load rate of the tractor CAN network meets the design requirements.

articleTitle: Research on Foreign Language Corpus Model of Chatbot ChatGPT under New Era Artificial Intelligence Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The large-scale text generation model represented by ChatGPT has attracted extensive attention because of its great potential in text. Corpus, an educational research resource, is also undergoing a productive transformation. The text segmentation feature extraction model is obtained by modifying the dictionary learning method. This method replaces the original sample by high order feature representation and dictionary learning. Through text preprocessing, text network construction, feature extraction and feature weight analysis, a segmentation feature extraction method for English corpus is established. The method designed in this project can better grasp the relationship between the sentences in the text. The weight is determined by emotion and attribute value, so as to provide a more complete identification basis for the translation.

articleTitle: Development of E-Commerce Recommendation System Based on FP-Growth Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Association rule mining is a process of finding frequent patterns among database, relational database and other item sets of large data. FP-Growth algorithm is one of the typical recommendation algorithms based on association rules. Firstly, the relational rules and FP-Growth algorithm are studied. Then, the electronic commerce recommendation system is designed, including the overall structure design and core function design. Then, the implementation of FP-Growth mining algorithm is studied, and the implementation flow of constructing FPtree and FP-Growth algorithm is designed. Finally, the system is tested with real e-commerce data, and the test results are output according to the steps of reading initial e-commerce data, calculating support, arranging by frequency, rewriting item set in transaction database, constructing FPtree and generating frequent item set. The main contribution of this paper is to deeply study the FP-Growth algorithm and provide a complete solution for the application of FP-Growth algorithm in e-commerce system.

articleTitle: A Method for Optimizing Control Parameters of Wind Turbines in High Wind Conditions
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In high wind condition, the wind-driven generator's power is susceptible to the wave of wind. As wind turbines become larger and larger, wind wave carries out more and more serious affection on electric system's stability, This essay introduce a new performance function which includes power wave data and speed wave data, then look for the most proper control parameters with optimization theory. Simulation proved that control parameters optimized can reduce power wave's amplitude obviously.

articleTitle: Research on Privacy Protection of Recommendation System Users Under Member Inference Attack Based on IMIA Defender Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With artificial intelligence entering a new era, recommendation systems are entering a stage of excellent development. It is necessary to propose a recommendation proposition that better meets the user's privacy protection needs, focusing on security thinking centered on user privacy. Using the dynamic evolution of the development of Federated Recommendation System (FedRecs), a theoretical analysis framework is developed based on the internal logic of privacy protection, which explains the development mechanism of FedRecs that is generated jointly by the federated learning mechanisms and privacy defense mechanisms involving users and service providers. Further, explores the possibility of moving towards the high-quality development goal of FedRecs from the perspective of privacy attack and defense changes and practical interpretations of FedTRecs. The purpose of the development of FedRecs is to provide users with recommendation services that meet expected standards and are committed to continuously improving recommendation quality and enhancing user satisfaction. For this purpose, it is necessary to strengthen privacy control based on the interaction-level member inference attack (IMIA) defender neural network, develop an interaction and feedback mechanism between FedRecs and user privacy perception, and establish a system for evaluating FedRecs and user privacy perception. In this way, the high-quality development of FedRecs can be realized, artificial intelligence security can be promoted, and user privacy can be truly satisfied.

articleTitle: Automatic Pricing and Replenishment Decision for Vegetables Based on Nonlinear Programming
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Due to the vegetable commodities with perishable, short shelf life characteristics, their appearance will gradually deteriorate with the growth of the sales time, so the fresh food superstore is often based on the previous sales of each commodity and demand for the day of replenishment of goods. In this paper, for the relationship between total sales and pricing, the paper first determines that the data show normal distribution through the frequency histogram. Next, the distribution of data points on the scatterplot is used to derive the trend of the total sales volume of each category with the average unit price of each category. Finally, by fitting the data points on the scatterplot once, twice, and three times, the relationship between total sales and pricing for each category is nonlinear. For giving the total daily replenishment and pricing strategy of the superstore from July 1–7, this paper uses a model of nonlinear programming problem to answer. Firstly, the ARIMA time series forecasting model is used to predict the total daily sales volume of each category of vegetables in the superstore for the next seven days based on the relevant data of June 2023, and accordingly, the range of daily replenishment and pricing of each category of vegetables in the superstore is determined. In addition, this paper also constrains the two based on the functional relationship equation between sales volume and pricing of each category. Finally, a series of results are calculated using the fmincon function in MATLAB.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Digital Twin Model of Power Communication Transmission Network Using Hybrid Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The ongoing advancement of the “Digital New Infrastructure” strategy has been leading the power and communication industry towards rapid development in digitalization, networking, and intelligence. Digital twin models form the foundational basis for realizing digital twinning. This paper elucidates the concept of digital twinning and, based on a hybrid model, constructs a digital twin model for the power communication network. It employs multi-site, multi-level 3D point cloud data to reconstruct the physical models of various resource components. Through a combination of mechanistic models and data-driven models, it uncovers inherent patterns to build a behavioral model for the twinning system. The behavioral model drives the physical model to achieve synchronous operation of the physical network and the twin system. Ultimately, it realizes the application of digital twinning within the communication facility.

articleTitle: The Node2vec Algorithm of Network Structure Based on Wavelet Coefficients Sampling
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: As information technology is constantly developing towards networking, various network embedding methods have emerged to deeply explore the inherent characteristics of network data. There is limited research using network topology information and node attribute information in the N ode2vec algorithm of network structure. This study develops a new sampling method to use the ability of wavelet coefficients to describe structure information, introducing wavelet coefficients sampling to replace traditional sampling methods. The new sampling measurement method combined with spatial neural networks can simultaneously consider topology information and node attributes. This study conduct a series of node classification experiments using samples with different sizes and neighborhoods from publicly available datasets in various fields to validate the effectiveness of the algorithm. The findings of this study suggest that we can effectively improve algorithm performance by using the characteristics of wavelet coefficients to sample nodes and combining it with spatial neural networks as a new sampling method.

articleTitle: Research on Hollow Beam Based on Cross-Phase Modulation
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: A hollow beam is a ring-shaped beam with a zero central intensity, which has wide applications in particle manipulation and super-resolution microscopy imaging. Based on this, this paper proposes a method for obtaining hollow beams based on cross-phase modulation, which has the advantages of simple structure, strong controllability, and low laser power requirement. Firstly, the intensity distribution of the outgoing hollow beam is explored from both theoretical derivation and numerical simulation. The simulation results are in excellent agreement with the theory, proving the feasibility of this method. Secondly, the intensity distribution images of beams with self-phase modulation and cross-phase modulation are compared, and the results show that under the same conditions, the number of rings in the cross-phase modulation is twice that of the self-phase modulation, which has stronger nonlinear effects than self-phase modulation.

articleTitle: UAV Target Detection and Path Planning Based on Improved YOLOv4 Networks with Improved Artificial Potential Field Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In recent years, with the rise of the application of deep learning tasks in the end of multi-rotor UAVs, it is a very scientifically meaningful and practical research to combine artificial intelligence technology with pattern recognition technology to realize automatic target detection and autonomous obstacle avoidance in UAVs. The traditional manual inspection method has the problems of low efficiency, high labor and material consumption and low safety, so the country is vigorously developing the drone industry at this stage. UAV inspection tasks are becoming more and more important, and it has become a trend for UAVs to shift to the direction of unmanned operations. With the increase of UAV density in large cities, it is meaningful to control and manage the trajectory of UAVs and provide intelligent trajectory optimization and anti-collision system. In order to achieve safe and fast autonomous flight, it is necessary to intelligently optimize the flight trajectory of UAV to ensure the best response time and increase the duration of continuous flight. At the same time, due to the low-slow-small characteristics of UAVs and the complexity of cities, UAVs are often faced with the interference of airborne obstacles, such as utility poles or flying birds, and need to perform real-time environment sensing and change their trajectories in time to avoid these obstacles. We propose an ED-YOLO network model for target detection of UAV obstacles. The target detection algorithm is based on YOLOv4, and firstly, a channel attention mechanism is added to the backbone network to improve the detection accuracy without increasing the computation. Compared with YOLOv4, its average accuracy mean of obstacle target detection is only reduced by 1.4%, while the model volume is reduced by 94.9%, the floating-point operation volume is reduced by 82.1%, and the prediction speed is improved by 2.3 times. We also studied UAV obstacle avoidance path planning. Firstly, we propose the UAV obstacle avoidance strategy, secondly, we introduce the traditional artificial potential field method and analyze the defects of this algorithm, and then we propose a solution and conduct simulation and comparison tests in MATLAB software to illustrate its effectiveness.

articleTitle: Research on Image Restoration Processing Based on Gaussian Blur Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Blur is a decrease in image clarity caused by incorrect focusing, motion blur, or lens distortion of the image. Image restoration is the process of restoring degraded images as much as possible, following the inverse process of image degradation. Blur refers to the blurring or blurring of image details, and Gaussian blur is a commonly used model in image and signal degradation. This article is based on image processing theory. Firstly, a mathematical model for image degradation is constructed to lay the foundation for image restoration in response to this degradation process; Next, study Gaussian fuzzy logic and quantitatively describe the uncertainty within the image system using fuzzy membership functions; Then, the basic process of image restoration based on Gaussian blur algorithm is studied, including image denoising, obtaining the point spread function of the image, and using constrained least squares method to restore the image; Finally, study the quality evaluation of image restoration, including subjective and objective evaluations, and demonstrate the superiority of Gaussian blur algorithm through experimental comparative analysis.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control of Hierarchical DC Step-Up Converter for Methanol RMFC
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper proposes to apply the hierarchical DC boost DAB-Boost converter to the methanol reforming fuel cell (RMFC) power generation system, which can solve the problem of electrical isolation and DC boost in RMFC power generation systems in high-power application scenarios. It is also capable of handling a wide range of changes in the output voltage of methanol RMFCs and the transmission of energy efficiently. Design a model and controller for this converter and use dual phase-shift control on the front-stage converter and dual closed-loop control on the rear-stage converter to optimize the control strategy. Finally, the experiment confirmed the converter's stable DC boost function and the rationality of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Integrating Sentiment Analysis and Knowledge Graphs for Enhanced Stock Trend Prediction-A Deep Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Stock trend prediction has always been a focal point of interest for both the academic and industrial sectors, owing to its complex nature influenced by various factors. This paper proposes an innovative approach to stock trend prediction by integrating sentiment analysis and knowledge graphs with deep learning techniques. Our methodology encompasses three major aspects: historical stock data, news articles, and fluctuations in related stocks. Utilizing Long Short- Term Memory (LSTM) networks, we delve into the historical stock data to uncover underlying temporal dependencies and employ attention mechanisms to accentuate pivotal features that contribute significantly to stock trend forecasting. We further enhance our model by integrating news text information, capturing the essence of key events and their potential impacts on stock movements. Recognizing the spatial correlations in stock trends influenced by geographical, industrial, and technological factors, we also incorporate a Graph Convolutional Network (GCN) based model to encapsulate the relationships between different stock entities. By amalgamating features derived from stock trading data and news headlines, our model learns both node features and inter- node relationships, thereby enriching the prediction model. The empirical results showcase the efficacy of our approach, highlighting its potential in delivering more accurate and reliable stock trend predictions. Through this research, we contribute to the growing body of knowledge in financial analytics and open avenues for future work focusing on the fusion of diverse data sources for enhanced stock market forecasting.

articleTitle: Design and Experiment of a Rapid Cattle Weighing System Based on Internet of Things Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to improve the efficiency and accuracy of weighing, a rapid weighing system for cattle based on Internet of Things technology is designed in response to the massive, repetitive, and essential weighing of cattle in the process of large-scale beef cattle breeding. Faced with the increasing cost of labor, this paper proposes a rapid weighing system for cattle based on Internet of Things technology. This article designs a rapid cattle weighing system based on Internet of Things technology. The system consists of a guidance channel, weighing device, PLC control system, identity recognition system, data communication module, touch screen, livestock weighing management software, etc., which can achieve the goal of quickly obtaining and processing cow weight data. The system utilizes wireless radio frequency identification technology to obtain individual information of cattle; Using infrared photoelectric switches to obtain cattle position information; Utilizing weighing sensor technology to obtain cow weight data, and utilizing network and communication technologies to achieve information and data exchange; Using livestock weighing management software, complete data processing and send relevant instructions to the PLC control system to control the actions of executing components. After cattle weighing experiments and validation analysis, the relative error of the obtained cattle weight data can be controlled below ± 2 % within a weighing time of 6–8 s/head, which can meet the accuracy requirements of cattle weight data in the breeding process of the farm. Compared with traditional static weighing methods, this system can reduce weighing time and save labor. The preliminary test results indicate that the system operates stably, with small deviation in multiple measurement results, and good stability. The results of the daily weight gain test for cattle are consistent with those obtained by traditional static weighing methods, and can quickly, accurately, and automatically collect cattle weight data. It can be used as one of the methods for weighing cattle in large-scale beef cattle farms and has great practicality.

articleTitle: Design of RFID Access Control System Based on Raspberry Pie
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper focuses on the research background and status of the system design of RAFID access control based on raspberry pie, the construction of hardware circuits, the working principle of each module, the design of software programs and the process of physical debugging. The main reason for setting up the topic is to change the original human guard. Although the original human guard was flexible, but the irreversible personnel mobilization could not be quickly adjusted, resulting in management loopholes. The modern access control system not only reduces labor costs, but also makes flow management more standardized. In this paper, through the detection of face feature information and RFID card identification code, the data collected is transmitted to the raspberry pie through the trigger module (photo module and RFID module), and the raspberry dispatch database or photo library is compared and verified. If the match is successful, it will also be transferred to the computer to display the measured results, and then let the driver module operate to open the valve. This raspberry pie design raspberry pie as the core module, the function of RFID plus face recognition is the innovation of this access system, as long as one of the two recognition successes can open the door valve. This design, through the face recognition principle, RFID recognition principle, WiFi communication methods and other aspects of mastery and analysis, has planned and designed to complete the convergence between various modules, and finally completed the design, to achieve access control systems of two recognition modes.

articleTitle: Research on Fire Detection Method of Surveillance Video in Laboratory Management Based on Deep Learning and Motion Features
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Fire detection of surveillance video in laboratory management is an important security work. In this paper, a fire detection method based on deep learning and motion features is proposed to improve the accuracy and real-time performance of fire recognition. In the first part, this paper introduces the application background of fire surveillance video and the application of deep learning in video analysis. A fire detection system, including a data acquisition module, video preprocessing module, and fire recognition module, is designed. In the fire recognition module, we adopted a hybrid model based on a convolutional neural network and a long short-term memory network. We used motion features and visual features to judge the situation. Furthermore, we trained and optimized the model and verified the effectiveness and performance of the model through experiments. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper has high accuracy, recall ratio, and F1 value in fire recognition and can realize real-time processing. This paper proposes a new scheme that provides new ideas and technologies for fire detection and video surveillance in laboratory management.

articleTitle: Path Planning of Materials Distribution Robot for Sports Games Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Machine delivery is gradually replacing human delivery as the mainstream development trend in material delivery for large-scale comprehensive sports events. In addition to having high requirements for hardware devices such as communication modules and sensor modules, material delivery robots also play a crucial role in path planning algorithms. The path planning module is equivalent to the brain of material delivery robots, determining the efficiency and quality of the entire delivery process. This article is based on the basic problem solving mathematical model. Firstly, the mathematical model and implementation process of the standard particle swarm optimization algorithm are studied. Then, in response to the existing problems, improvements are made from three aspects: inertia weight, acceleration factor, and limited particle velocity. Experimental simulation research is conducted using Schaffer fitness function. The results show that due to the advantages of fewer parameters and easy implementation of the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm, using the improved particle swarm optimization algorithm to solve the path planning of the sports meeting material delivery robot can obtain high-performance path planning and allocation schemes.

articleTitle: Supermarket Replenishment and Pricing Decisions Based on a Single-Objective Planning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Vegetables contain rich nutritional value and are an indispensable part of people's daily lives, but their freshness period is relatively short and susceptible to the influence of season, temperature, time and other factors, so the development of reasonable pricing decisions is of great significance to the revenue. In this paper, firstly, we use Spearman's correlation coefficient to study the intrinsic relationship between the commodities for sale in order to explore the correlation between the sales volume of commodities. Second, we develop a single-objective planning model to optimize the replenishment and pricing strategy decisions. Finally, in order to consider the impact of inventory on the replenishment strategy, we introduce inventory constraints on top of the original constraints and build a 0–1 dynamic planning model to further optimize the replenishment decision. With this model, we can develop an optimal replenishment strategy with constrained inventory levels to achieve better business results.

articleTitle: Research on On-Line Monitoring Technology of CO2 in Boiler Combustion and Analysis of Emission Reduction
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this paper, an online monitoring method of CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions from power generation enterprises is introduced. An on-line monitoring system for CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> emissions from boiler combustion was developed and successfully operated in a power plant. Through the installation, operation and data processing analysis of the system, on the basis of obtaining high-quality carbon emission monitoring data, how to use carbon emission monitoring data to save energy and reduce carbon emissions in thermal power plants is studied.

articleTitle: Stock price prediction based on optimized BP neural network
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Affected by various factors, stock price movement is difficult to predict and often accompanied by high risk. This paper proposes a particle swarm algorithm to optimize the traditional BP neural network model to predict the next day's closing price of CSI 300 data. Firstly, the BP neural network and the improved PSO-BP neural network model are constructed respectively. Next, we decide on suitable model parameters and establish that the ideal number for the hidden layer is 5. Finally, we use RMSE and MAE as the evaluation indexes to measure the model prediction accuracy, and find that the PSO-BP is significantly better than the traditional BP neural network in predicting the future stock prices.

articleTitle: Research on Vegetable Commodity Pricing and Replenishment Strategy Based on Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In fresh food superstores, the freshness period of most vegetable products is relatively short, and the quality of vegetables will deteriorate due to the increase in storage time and cannot be sold on the next day, so it is very important to determine the total daily replenishment for superstores. This paper discusses the optimization problem of daily replenishment total and pricing decisions. In this paper, firstly, the bivariate correlation coefficient analysis is carried out using SPSS to calculate the correlation coefficients between the total sales volume of each category and the unit price of sales; secondly, the regression model is established to derive the fitting equations and the R2 the test is carried out. For the superstore revenue optimization problem, firstly, the total daily replenishment strategy model of each vegetable category was established, and secondly, the pricing strategy model of each vegetable category was established through the wholesale price and sales unit price. Considering the transportation loss and deterioration of vegetables, the goods will be sold at a discount, this paper establishes the pricing strategy model of undiscounted and discounted sales. Finally, the optimal model is obtained based on the simulated annealing algorithm to ensure revenue maximization. The final maximum returns (RMB) from July 1–7, 2023 are 8091.56, 8102.48, 8097.47, 8114.66, 8166.51, 8115.96, and 8126.11, respectively.

articleTitle: Prediction of Water Quality of Xincheng Bridge in Lanzhou Based on CNN-LSTM Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Water quality prediction (WQP) is a basic and advanced aspect of water resource management and water pollution prevention and control. Dissolved oxygen serves as a crucial indicator for assessing the quality of river water. Therefore, precise estimation of dissolved oxygen levels can enable timely evaluation of the state of river water quality, facilitating improved river management. so as to improve the performance and generalization ability of the LSTM water quality prediction model, this study focuses on the periodic and nonlinear characteristics of water quality changes. Specifically, the dissolved oxygen (DO) content of Xincheng Bridge in Lanzhou is selected as the research subject. To achieve this, a prediction model called CNN-LSTM is developed by integrating the convolution neural network (CNN) and the long short-term memory network (LSTM). This model demonstrates efficient extraction of water quality characteristic information and enables accurate time series prediction. The prediction error of the model is lower compared to that of the LSTM model. Additionally, the mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean square error (RMSE) of the predicted value (PV) are 13.05% and 4.905% lower than those of the LSTM model, respectively. The accuracy of predicting larger and smaller values is higher, resulting in improved generalization performance.

articleTitle: Automatic Pricing and Replenishment Decision Based on WSO-BiLSTM and Nonlinear Programming
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Automatic pricing and replenishment decision-making requires fresh food superstores to make decisions on whether to stock, how much to stock, and how to price based on the historical sales data and demand of each commodity, and after making a full understanding of the information on sales flow, wholesale price, and wastage rate of each commodity. In this paper, based on WSO-BiLSTM and the nonlinear programming model, the optimization of replenishment and pricing strategy of vegetable commodities formulated by superstores is realized. Firstly, the total sales volume of each vegetable category and the single item is visualized, the correlation of each vegetable category is analyzed by the Pearson correlation coefficient, and the correlation of the sales volume of each single vegetable item is analyzed by Spearman correlation coefficient. Then, the relationship between the total sales volume of each vegetable category and the cost markup is analyzed, fitted using the support vector machine regression SVR nonparametric method, predicted using the long- and short-term recurrent neural network LSTM model, and the model is improved by introducing the WSO-BiLSTM model, which predicts the total daily replenishment volume in the next seven days, and the pricing decision is made to achieve the maximum revenue for the superstore. Finally, considering various types of constraints, a nonlinear planning model is established, and this planning model is converted into a 0–1 knapsack problem. The greedy algorithm is used to obtain the globally optimal solution, which gives a reasonable replenishment amount of single product and pricing strategy, making the hypermarket revenue maximized. The proposed model is close to reality and has high accuracy.

articleTitle: Emotion Recognition and Treatment Based on Multi-Feature Signal Fusion and Deep Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Music is an expression of mood and emotion, and listening to music is an effective non-pharmacological tool with many benefits for quality of life and well-being. Good music can have a positive effect on mood, allowing human listeners to reduce anxiety, increase mental energy and motivation, and is believed to have analgesic and anxiolytic properties. The various physiological and psychological effects of music therapy on humans have been reported in the literature, and the effects of music on physiology and behavior have been studied in animals. Many studies have concluded that animals are also affected by music. Both the rhythmic and spectral distributions of music can convey emotional meaning, and these features have been shown in altering the behavior of animals.
