In this paper, we first constructed an emotion recognition model for cats based on multi-channel physiological signals, selecting EEG, ECG, and respiratory signals that are closely related to emotions, and utilizing the representational complementarity between multiple signals to construct a feature-level fusion emotion recognition model, which can effectively recognize a variety of emotions in cats. The experimental results show that the average accuracy of recognition has been effectively improved. Second, a music classification recognition network based on LSTM network was designed so as to obtain the most effective music styles and attributes that enhance the cat's emotions and help the cat alleviate negative emotions. The network shares the interpretation layer of classification on the basis of LSTM network, which can greatly reduce the learning of model parameters and improve the learning efficiency.

articleTitle: Apply Knowledge Graphs to Explore New Paradigms of Scientific Research
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Based on the information extraction technology, large number of scientific research reports were text mined, the modular knowledge extraction method was applied, and the domain knowledge graph was constructed by the top-down association rules. This paper explores the means of extracting structured knowledge from massive texts, reveals the development disciplines of lCT, and provides tools for researchers to explore new paradigms of scientific research.

articleTitle: Application Research of Adaptive Communication Protocol Adaptation Strategy in Substation Fire Automation System
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The adaptive communication protocol scheme can effectively solve the problem of using different communication protocols between fire equipment from different manufacturers. It allows real-time communication between devices, regardless of the communication protocol they use, thereby improving system interoperability and helping to improve overall system efficiency and data availability. The adaptive scheme of different communication protocols helps to achieve automated device configuration and management, reduces the secondary development work required for communication protocol adaptation, and improves the maintainability of the system.

articleTitle: Research on Financial Risk Early Warning System Based on Computer Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this paper, the feature extraction method of financial text is firstly established based on Bidirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers and autoencoder. The author suggests to add loopback connection in the financial data mining process, so that the financial data mining process has a loopback structure. The limitation of this model in information system is overcome by means of database and batch document. The research shows that the financial text features extracted from the Bidirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers can enhance the prediction effect of the four financial early warning models on AUC. It shows that Bidirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers can extract the characteristics of financial text well to enhance the ability to predict the financial market.

articleTitle: The Control of Dual-Input DC-DC Converter System Based on Fuzzy MPPT
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Based on the dual-input Buck / Buck-Boost DC-DC converter, a dual-input combined power supply system is constructed and its topology and working principle are analyzed in this paper. The two input power supplies are hydrogen-oxygen fuel cell and photovoltaic cell. The system adopts master-slave energy control, uses fuzzy control to track the maximum power point of photovoltaic cells and preferentially uses photovoltaic cells for energy supply. The hydrogen-oxygen fuel cell is used as an auxiliary power supply supplemented by PID control to achieve stable power supply of the combined system. The simulation model is built in MATLAB. The simulation results show that the power supply system can realize photovoltaic priority energy supply, and has the advantages of fast output response and good output dynamic characteristics.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Storage of Epidemic Prevention and Relief Materials Based on Bar Code Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to realize the intelligent storage management ability of epidemic prevention and relief materials, a design scheme of intelligent storage system for epidemic prevention and relief materials based on bar code recognition is proposed. The bar code of the system includes sample bar code, location bar code, warehouse bar code, etc., and the method of “bar code graphics+inventory information+location code” is adopted to realize the time stamp of epidemic prevention and relief materials and the reorganization of the basic data structure of sample PDM. Through the methods of sample quantity management and storage location information management, the information report management of intelligent storage of epidemic prevention and relief materials is realized, the logistics scheduling algorithm design of epidemic prevention and relief materials is realized according to bar code recognition method, the geographical location information and load information of epidemic prevention and relief materials logistics vehicles are collected through the Internet of Things, and the low-cost intelligent storage management and logistics transportation of epidemic prevention and relief materials are realized by combining vehicle network and vehicle scheduling optimization strategy. The test results show that this method can effectively realize the intelligent storage management of epidemic prevention and relief materials, reduce transportation costs, and ensure the timeliness and safety of logistics goods tracking and management.

Author Keywords: Materials for epidemic prevention and relief

articleTitle: Research on the Collaborative Interaction between Electricity and Computing Power for Green Development-Taking Data Centers as an Example
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The allocation of electricity and computing resources is an important factor affecting economic development and social stability. Through research on the coordinated operation of computing power and electricity, resource allocation can be optimized, resource utilization efficiency can be improved, investment in power grid construction can be reduced, fossil energy consumption and carbon emissions can be reduced, and low-carbon and green development of electricity can be promoted. This article takes data centers as an example to study and analyze the planning and operation related issues of computing power collaboration. The focus is on the perspective of power supply and demand balance, and proposes a theoretical method for data centers to participate in demand response and achieve collaborative interaction with the power grid. Firstly, the composition of the adjustable load potential of the data center and the mechanism of participating in grid interaction were analyzed. Then, a data center energy supply and load energy consumption model is established. Finally, considering delay sensitive loads and delay tolerant loads, based on the time scheduling mechanism, spatial scheduling mechanism, and server optimization management mechanism of the data center, a potential calculation model for the participation of the data center in power demand response is proposed. This study provides theoretical support for the inclusion of the data center in power grid scheduling.

articleTitle: Research on Task Planning and Efficiency Evaluation of Multi-Agent Collaborative Search Based on Ant Colony Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the development of intelligent technology, multi-agent collaborative search task planning has become an important application, such as UAV swarm and robot detection. This paper proposes a method based on ant colony optimization to plan multi-agent cooperative search tasks. The global search ability and adaptability of ant colony optimization are used to find the optimal multi-agent cooperative search path. At the same time, we consider the communication and cooperation constraints between multi-agents. We used fuzzy neural network and principal component analysis to evaluate the efficiency of multi-agent collaborative search task planning. The sample library and training model are constructed to obtain the efficiency evaluation index of multi-agent collaborative search task planning. This paper uses numerical examples to verify the effectiveness and superiority of multi-agent collaborative search task planning based on ant colony optimization. It analyzes the impact of different parameters and model structures on the evaluation results. Furthermore, this paper provides new ideas and methods for multi-agent collaborative search task planning, which is of great significance in improving the performance and efficiency of multi-agent systems.

articleTitle: Research on Bearing Fault Detection Method Based on Wavelet Transform and K-means Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Rolling bearings are critical parts in rotating machinery and equipment, and their failure may cause equipment damage and production accidents. As a result, it is of great importance to detect rolling bearing faults. Based on K-means clustering, this paper proposes a method for detecting rolling bearing faults. The first step in the process is to collect the operating data of the rolling bearing, which is obtained through multiple sensors, such as vibration signals, sound signals, and current signals. Effective time domain and frequency domain features are extracted from these original signals. As a next step, the K-means clustering algorithm is used to cluster the features to identify the failure modes. Lastly, the clustering results are used to diagnose and judge faults. In experimental verification, this method has demonstrated good performance in detecting rolling bearing faults and can provide reliable support for monitoring and maintaining equipment.

articleTitle: Research on Identification and Early Warning Method of Power Customer Complaint Risk Based on SACNN Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Customer service feedback plays an important role in the sustainable development of electric power enterprises. In order to reduce the risk of customer complaints and increase the service quality of power enterprises, the SACNN model is applied to identify and warn the risk of customer complaints. On the premise of analyzing the risk categories and causes of complaints from electricity customers, the research innovatively proposes a method of identifying complaints and early warning methods for electricity customers, and gives corresponding strategies for the reasons of complaints. The optimal number of hidden layer nodes, the number of batches, and the number of iterations of the SACNN model are about 200, 25, and 700, respectively. The number of months of misjudgment of the risk of customer complaints of electricity customers by the method of risk identification and early warning given by the research is 5 and 3, respectively, which has a very high risk identification rate of customer complaints. Can improve customer satisfaction with electricity.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Attitude Detection of Underactuated Planar Flexible Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to improve the dynamic analysis and control capabilities of flexible robotic arms, an automatic attitude detection method for underactuated planar flexible robotic arms based on arm angle parameterized redundant motion feature detection is proposed. Construct a DH parameter kinematic analysis model for an underactuated planar flexible robotic arm, use a fixed vector arm angle parameterization analysis method to extract the inertial features of the flexible robotic arm's attitude. Based on the DH modeling theory, the end pose modeling parameters of the robot arm were obtained. The inertia and friction parameters of the MBC controller of the robot arm were identified by the parametric redundant motion feature detection method of the arm Angle, and the arm Angle modeling of the minimum motion transformation model of the robot arm was realized, a forward algorithm for the minimum motion transformation model is designed to achieve the attitude parameter fitting control of the robotic arm. Use the arm angle parameterization method to solve the inverse kinematic model, and achieve automatic detection of the underactuated planar flexible robotic arm attitude. The simulation results show that using this method for flexible robotic arm attitude detection verifies that the inverse kinematics algorithm can solve kinematic problems of the robotic arm within a very small error range in terms of accuracy, computational efficiency, and optimal arm angle. The tracking errors of the kinematic position of the robotic arm in attitude space of the proposed method are all low, the highest is only 0.224 mm, effectively solving the algorithm singularity problem caused by the failure of arm angle definition, and improving control stability.

articleTitle: Clinical Intelligent Diagnosis and Treatment of Hemorrhagic Stroke Based on Random Forest and BP-Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper focuses on the early identification and prediction of hematoma expansion and perihematoma edema after hemorrhagic stroke. By applying advanced machine learning algorithms, such as random forests and BP neural networks, patients' personal and disease histories as well as clinical imaging data were comprehensively analyzed. First, within 48 hours of disease onset, the random forest algorithm identified hematoma expansion in 23 of the first 100 patients. Second, variables such as history of diabetes mellitus, history of coronary artery disease, and HM _volume were analyzed using a multiple linear regression model to predict the patient's 90-day mRS score. Finally, the association between 90-day mRS scores and multiple factors was further explored by BP neural network and gray correlation analysis, and specific diagnostic and therapeutic recommendations were made based on the findings.

articleTitle: Research on Decentralized Task Allocation and Collaboration Based on Multiple AUVs
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In the 21st century, extensive human engagement in activities such as marine resource exploration, maritime transportation, and maritime security has led to a deeper understanding of the oceans. This increased interest has spotlighted Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUVs), which possess the capability to operate independently and covertly, making them a preferred choice for diverse underwater tasks. However, as underwater missions grow in complexity, the limitations of individual AUVs have spurred the exploration of multi-AUV systems. These systems offer higher efficiency, greater intelligence, and enhanced fault tolerance, rendering them indispensable in both deep-sea search and rescue missions and national maritime security efforts. Task allocation is a central challenge in the realm of multi-AUV systems. Balancing factors like search environments, ocean currents, obstacles, and target locations, various intelligent optimization methods have been employed. This paper references representative works to explore genetic algorithm-based decentralized task allocation and Hungarian algorithm-based decentralized task allocation, examining their potential to enhance cooperative underwater searches. Centralized task allocation faces robustness and scalability concerns, necessitating decentralized alternatives, particularly for mobile multi-agent systems. The presented research underscores the significance of decentralized methodologies in optimizing multi-AUV task assignments. The paper elucidates these two approaches, discusses their implications, and concludes by presenting an analysis of the results. Through this study, the paper contributes to advancing the field of multi-AUV systems and their effective coordination for efficient underwater search operations.

articleTitle: Self-Supervised Learning for Swine Ear-Tag Classification with Attention Module Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: We proposed an attention-based deep framework for animal ear-tag classification in the livestock industry. In addition to spatial and channel attention, the model incorporated squeeze excitation block that performed channel-wise feature calibration to improve the model representation power. Moreover, this backbone was transferred to self-learning model on unlabeled data - Barlow Twins and combined with focal loss. We investigated the impact of ear-tag crop size from the original frame to achieve desirable efficiency and to reduce noise in the images, such as the pen or swine. The model was trained on manually annotated data collected at a swine farm in Norway to validate our approach. The results of model were presented in terms of two performance metrics: accuracy and F-score. A comprehensive comparison with state-of-the-art model was conducted, and more than 10% improvement was achieved. The ablation study was also performed and proved the effectiveness of our approach.

articleTitle: E-Commerce Demand Forecasting Based on Time Series Analysis and Commodity Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The problem of demand forecasting for e-commerce retail merchants is a common challenge in the e-commerce industry. The key lies in how to accurately predict customer demand and solve practical problems based on the prediction results. The research on this topic facilitates e-commerce platforms to adjust their inventory in a timely manner so as to not only satisfy customer demand but also effectively reduce inventory costs and operating costs. It is in line with the development trend of the e-commerce retail industry, such as intelligence, personalization and customization, and the integration of online and offline. In this paper, a hybrid ARIMA-LR model is first used to forecast the demand for different storage sites of e-commerce. This model combines an autoregressive sliding average model (ARIMA) and a linear regression model (LR) to improve prediction accuracy and stability. Then, a genetic algorithm is used to select the best classification metrics. In this paper, based on the performance of different classification metrics, a genetic algorithm is used to select the most suitable metrics from them to classify different time series. By classifying time series into different categories, the patterns and features of the same type of series can be better understood and analyzed. This helps to extract useful information, identify potential trends and patterns, and provide decision support for demand management of e-commerce warehouse sites.

articleTitle: Enhancing Interactive Storytelling: A Computational Approach to Autonomously Generating Role-Playing Game Scripts with Natural Language Processing
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In the realm of role-playing games (RPGs), the crafting of rich and detailed narratives is crucial, with legendary games like Dungeons & Dragons (D&D) setting the bar for creativity and player-driven storytelling. This research explores the innovative intersection of artificial intelligence and RPGs by developing a method for the automated generation of RPG scripts, harnessing the capabilities of advanced natural language processing (NLP). Our study presents an elaborate NLP framework, utilizing a comprehensive collection of D&D source materials, to methodically extract key character features (such as attributes, races, and classes) using machine learning techniques. This framework is further enhanced by integrating sentiment analysis and a sophisticated bi-directional recurrent neural network equipped with a multi-head attention mechanism. This combination is instrumental in accurately modeling narrative elements like event sequences, causal relationships, and thematic links. The culmination of this process is the automated generation of diverse and engaging RPG scripts, each characterized by distinct character dynamics, immersive settings, and compelling story arcs. The effectiveness and impact of these generated scripts were evaluated through a user study that gathered both qualitative and quantitative data. The findings demonstrate our system's proficiency in creating narratives that are not only contextually diverse but also resonate deeply with RPG conventions, indicating a significant advancement in interactive storytelling. This research not only reinforces the role of AI in augmenting game design but also underscores the broader potential of AI in creative content generation, marking a new era in the synergy between computational technology and artistic narrative creation.

articleTitle: Optimization of Unmanned Helicopter Transmission Line Inspection and Fire Extinguishing Procedures
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: To address the challenges posed by the complex processes of unmanned helicopter transmission line inspection and fire extinguishing, this paper analyzes the inspection and fire extinguishing procedures separately. We establish and validate practical Petri net models for both unmanned helicopter inspection and fire extinguishing processes. Subsequently, we integrate the unmanned helicopter inspection and fire extinguishing procedures by analyzing and improving the synchronization and conflict relationships between their subnets. The result is an optimized integrated workflow for unmanned helicopter inspection and fire extinguishing. The optimized process shows a reduction of 39.1% in operation time and a 50% decrease in unmanned helicopter transportation distance. The study demonstrates a significant enhancement in efficiency and resource utilization in the context of unmanned helicopter-based inspection and fire extinguishing operations.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Improved DPoS Consensus Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: To solve the concerns of malicious node removal and node corruption caused by idle node voting and long election cycles of the Delegated Proof of Stake (DPoS) consensus process, a new solution is proposed. First, we design a time-cost-based incentive mechanism that provides commensurate compensation to all nodes participating in the consensus strive system nodes to participate in voting actively. Second, we present a reward and punishment scheme based on trust value that sets the node status and corresponding trust value for nodes and dynamically adjusts the node status and associated trust value by monitoring node behavior and provides the function Optimization is performed to make it more difficult for bad nodes to get votes, to speed up the removal of wicked nodes, and to resist node bribery attacks. Finally, a list of alternate witness nodes is included to address the issue of system security weakening caused by the vacancy of hostile nodes once their proxies are revoked. The experimental results before and after the mechanism modification are compared to validate the usability and effectiveness of the improvement scheme.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Artificial Intelligence in Mobile Communication Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Artificial intelligence technology improves the performance and effectiveness of communication network technology, taking artificial intelligence as the research object and exploring its application in communication network technology, channel estimation method based on EM algorithm and channel estimation method based on deep learning are proposed respectively, which provide certain reference significance for the research and application of artificial intelligence in communication network technology.

articleTitle: Demand Forecasting and Optimization of Express Service Based on Arima and Optimal Path Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the rapid growth of courier service demand, predicting courier transportation demand is crucial for courier companies. This study analyzes issues such as city importance, courier transportation prediction, transportation plan optimization, and courier demand prediction by utilizing the Entropy Weight Method and Topsis Comprehensive Evaluation Model, ARIMA Time Series Model, and Dijkstra's Optimal Path Model. In the first problem, we use a comprehensive evaluation method based on the Entropy Weight Method and Topsis model, considering the importance of site cities from multiple perspectives and giving the weight of each indicator. According to the weight calculation results of the Entropy Weight Method, the weights are as follows: total city receipt volume (16.134%), average daily city receipt volume (14.396%), downstream connections (12.863%), total city shipment volume (20.719%), upstream connections (7.827%), average daily city shipment volume (18.053%), maximum monthly receipt change (5.237%), maximum monthly delivery change (4.77%).In the second problem, we use the ARIMA time series prediction model to predict the courier transportation quantity between specific site cities on specific dates, as well as the total courier transportation quantity between all site cities on the day. In the third problem, we require the number of paths used between each site city not to exceed 5 and design the lowest cost transportation plan. We model the railway transportation network as a weighted directed graph, where the weights represent the fixed costs of various transportation routes. Through Dijkstra's optimal path model and algorithm, we obtained the minimum cost of each specified transportation route on the specified date and calculated the minimum cost for each day. Finally, the lowest transportation costs from April 23 to April 27 were 16810.18, 21786.25, 18951.36, 14674.35, 14003.91 respectively. After testing and analysis, we successfully established the model, analyzed the weight of each city indicator, accurately predicted the courier transportation quantity and minimum transportation cost between each city, and reasonably calculated the fixed demand for each quarter. In future work, we will further verify the robustness and accuracy of the model, and carry out parameter optimization and method improvement. At the same time, we will also apply this model to financial resource allocation, power production and distribution, human resources and management, etc., to expand its application range.

articleTitle: Automatic Pricing and Replenishment Strategy for Vegetables Based on Multivariate Nonlinear Modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Pricing strategy for vegetables occupies an extremely important position in business operations. Since vegetable commodities are time-sensitive, perishable, and price-sensitive, a reasonable pricing strategy can increase supermarket sales and customer satisfaction, as well as increase profits. Pricing needs to take into account not only the cost of the commodity but also market demand, competitive situation, consumer psychology, and other factors. In addition, the pricing strategy should be adjusted according to different seasons, geographic locations, and customer groups in order to maintain a competitive advantage. In conclusion, the pricing strategy of fresh food supermarkets needs to be scientific and flexible in order to adapt to the changing market environment. In this paper, firstly, the improved inverse proportion function is used to describe the relationship between the total sales volume of each vegetable category and cost-plus pricing, and the RMSE of the model for each category is obtained in the range of 0.25-0.5 after fitting the data, which indicates that the predicted value is very close to the real value, and the model fitting effect is better; and then, the time series analysis of the sales volume and the cost of each vegetable category is performed, and the time series analysis is based on the ARIMA model to complete the July 1–7, 2023 data forecast. In order to formulate the daily replenishment quantity and pricing strategy of each category of vegetables for July 1–7, 2023, the multivariate nonlinear constraint model was constructed based on the above model of the relationship between sales volume and cost plus pricing as well as the predicted data of sales volume and cost, and based on the discount factor and discount time point, and the model was solved through the Scipy library.

articleTitle: Construction and Study of Textual Association Network Based on Cosine Similarity Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: We propose an method for constructing a textual association network based on the cosine similarity algorithm. The method first extracts hot keywords and detects emerging trends, and then constructs the co-occurrence matrix and cosine similarity correlation matrix. On this basis, complex network analysis methods are further introduced to generate the co-occurrence association network and topic bipartite network. To validate the effectiveness of the method, this study applies the method to empirical data from the Natural Science Foundation and the Social Science Foundation over a ten-year period. Experimental results demonstrate that this analytical method can effectively reveal the relationships and trends among different research fields in recent years, providing valuable insights for promoting academic research communication and interdisciplinary collaboration. This research provides a novel perspective for exploring textual associations and has significant implications for understanding the relationships and trends among different topics in research domains.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Power Grid Planning for Comprehensive Transmission and Distribution Tariff Reform
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The reform of transmission and distribution electricity prices has put forward higher and more optimized requirements for power grid planning. Based on the requirements of the transmission and distribution electricity price reform, different types of planning efficiency and benefit index models for power grids are constructed, and the combined impact of historical planning project optimization, relative importance of various projects, and planning objective constraints are comprehensively considered. A power grid investment allocation and optimization model based on the efficiency and benefit index model is constructed, and the key uncertainty indicators affecting the efficiency and benefit index are analyzed based on the risk index model. The effectiveness of the method was verified by comparing it with traditional methods and core regulatory parameters of transmission and distribution electricity prices. In recent years, with the implementation of peak valley time of use electricity prices in multiple provinces, the original user load characteristics have been changed, resulting in a gradual reduction in the difference between peak and valley loads, which has had an impact on load forecasting in power grid planning.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Software-Defined Networking in Low Earth Orbit Satellite Remote Sensing Communications
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive solution for integrating Satellite de Sensoriamento Remoto (SSR) into LEO satellite networks. It uses the Task-Edge Graph (TEG) for modeling task flows and resources, and leverages Virtual Network Function (VNF) orchestration from Network Function Virtualization (NFV). To address static unicast routing challenges like uneven traffic distribution and network congestion, two innovative routing algorithms are introduced.The Node Disjoint-based Multipath (NDM) algorithm designs primary and backup paths based on the shortest propagation distance, allowing adaptive route switching. The Minimum Dynamic Cost (MDC) algorithm considers queuing, node processing delay, and path propagation delay to calculate dynamic costs, reducing resource wastage during route discovery. The paper provides a system model, introduces algorithms to address the challenges, and conducts comprehensive performance analysis through simulations. This research enhances SSR communication efficiency and reliability in LEO satellite networks, with potential applications in various scenarios.

articleTitle: Automated Pricing and Replenishment Decision for Vegetable Commodities Based on ARIMA Modeling and Linear Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Vegetable commodities are not easy to keep for a long time, and in order to meet consumer demand and cope with market changes, fresh food superstores need to replenish vegetable commodities. This paper focuses on the replenishment and pricing decision of vegetable commodities and establishes Pearson correlation analysis model, K-means clustering model, time series model, and linear programming model to solve the problem. First, analyze the distribution law of different categories of different single-item vegetable sales, introduce the Pearson correlation analysis model to analyze the correlation between each category, and use the K-means clustering model to analyze the relationship between the sales volume of each single item. Then, the formula for the replenishment volume is determined, the ARIMA time series model is used to predict the sales volume of each category in the coming week, and the linear regression model is used to determine the optimal markup rate as well as the maximum revenue of each category in the coming week. The proposed model is suitable for handling large amounts of data with high accuracy and flexibility.

articleTitle: Modeling of Deep-Sea Area Exploration and Optimization of Survey Lines
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The multi-wavelength sounding system has developed rapidly on the basis of improving the shortcomings of single-wavelength sounding. Considering the advantage that multi-wavelength bathymetry can emit dozens or even hundreds of beams at a time in the plane perpendicular to the track, and then receive the returned sound wave through the transducer, it is characterized by the measurement of a certain width of water depth strip with the ship's survey line as the axis. The coverage width of the multi-wavelength bathymetric strip launched by the survey ship at the current position is affected by the opening angle of the transducer and the depth of the water surface at the current position. In this paper, the effects of the line direction angle, seawater depth, multibeam transducer opening angle, and slope on the coverage width of the line are analyzed when the line direction has an angle with the projection of the seabed slope normal on the horizontal plane, and the mathematical model for calculating the coverage width of the multibeam bathymetry is established. The coverage width of the survey line is also calculated at each point of the given rectangular area to be surveyed. In order to optimize the survey line, the method of calculating the coverage overlap ratio of adjacent survey lines when the analysis of survey lines has an angle with the normal direction of the slope is first defined. By analyzing the relationship between seawater depth and survey line coverage width and overlap rate, a single-objective optimization model is established with the entry angle and position of the survey vessel as the optimization variables, the total travel distance as the optimization objective, and the requirement of overlap rate between adjacent survey line strips as the constraints. The model was solved using the particle swarm optimization algorithm and the idea of dynamic programming, and the optimal driving route was obtained when the overlap rate condition was satisfied, and the total length was 88900.7m (48.0025 nautical miles).

articleTitle: Application of Blockchain Consensus Algorithm Based on Reputation Mechanism in Logistics Cloud Platform
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In recent years, the market size of the global logistics industry has grown and the supply chain of logistics companies has expanded. The logistics industry is increasingly adopting digital technologies to optimize transportation, warehousing and supply chain management. However, problems such as information opacity, data tampering and information asymmetry have emerged in the logistics system, which pose challenges in areas such as supply chain management and cargo tracking. Blockchain can establish a distributed and tamper-proof database, which enables all participants to share reliable information and data, thus realizing more efficient, safe and reliable logistics and transportation. Therefore, this paper designs and implements a blockchain-based logistics information cloud platform to solve the above problems. In this paper, a consensus algorithm based on reputation mechanism, Proof of Reputation (PoR), is designed for the blockchain-based logistics information cloud platform. Based on the improved reputation consensus algorithm, this paper designs and implements a blockchain-based logistics information cloud platform, including the design of consensus framework and overall structure. Through the design of experimental tests, the system performance basically meets the actual needs, and the efficiency of information storage and traceability in the logistics process is effectively improved.

articleTitle: Vegetable Replenishment and Pricing Strategy Model Based on ARIMA Model and Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to improve the profit of superstores, this paper investigates the optimal strategy of replenishment and pricing of superstore vegetable products. In this paper, we first analyze the distribution law of the sales of different single vegetables in different categories, use the Pearson correlation coefficient to analyze the relationship between different categories of vegetables, and use the Spearman correlation coefficient to portray the relationship between different single vegetables. Then, the weighted average method is used to find the average pricing of different categories of vegetables, and a linear regression model is set up by the least squares method. On the basis of the above regression equations, the ARIMA model is used to predict the future sales volume, and a single-objective planning model is set up, and a particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to determine the replenishment plan and pricing strategy for the week in the vegetable category. Finally, the objective function is set, the multi-objective planning model is constructed, and the original multi-objective planning model is transformed into a single-objective planning model by considering one of the objective functions as a constraint, and the non-linear planning method is used for solving the problem to determine the specific replenishment plan and pricing strategy for a single product on a single day. The proposed model has a certain degree of realism and high computational efficiency.

articleTitle: Multi-Objective Optimal Scheduling of Active Distribution Network Considering Green Power Park System Access
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The coupling of cold, heat, electricity and energy is increasingly strengthened, and the optimization of integrated operation of multi-energy systems is a key concern. Based on the background of green power park system connecting to active distribution network, the coordinated dispatching of green power park system and active distribution network is studied. Firstly, the system scheduling model of green power park with comprehensive cost as optimization goal is established. Secondly, a multi-source coordinated scheduling model of active distribution network with distributed power supply, energy storage equipment and flexible load in green power park system is established. The objective functions are scheduling cost, load curve variance and renewable energy abandoned power. Thirdly, particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to solve the model. Finally, the effectiveness of the model and solution method is verified by an example analysis in the improved IEEE33 node system.

articleTitle: Buslane Passenger Flow Mining Based on Travel Chain Reduction
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Buslane, as the road network section with the most concentrated bus passenger flow, accurately identify bus passenger flow on buslane is a difficult and hot spot in bus route optimization and improvement research area. Based on the bus IC swipe card data, bus GPS data and bus line station data, this paper proposes an algorithm model based on bus travel chain to reduce the drop-off station and project the bus line passenger flow; combine the hidden Markov map matching algorithm, this paper builds a bus line matching road network algorithm model and a bus line multi-path calibration optimization method, which can automatically break the road network into link segment based on bus stations. Based on the bus line matching road network superimposed on the bus line passenger flow can quickly extract the bus corridor passenger flow. Applying the model results in Shenzhen show that: 2000 bus lines in Shenzhen, the bus travel chain matching rate is 92.4%, the bus line matching road network accuracy is 95%, the line network matching and single day passenger flow projection running time is about 3 hours. The proposed method of buslane passenger flow mining can efficiently and automatically complete the whole analysis process from line network matching to passenger flow extraction, and the high degree of automation and mining accuracy of buslane passenger flow mining has important application value for the optimization of city-level buslane settings.

articleTitle: Intelligent Operation and Maintenance of Oil-Gas-Water Multiphase Pipelines: A Hybrid Modeling Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 3rd International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In the mid to late stages of oilfield development, the frequency of incidents and leaks in oil-gas-water multiphase pipelines poses significant risks. Traditional manual pipeline operations face considerable challenges, necessitating the adoption of intelligent technologies. This study employs a hybrid modeling approach, combining mechanistic models with data-driven AI models. Using a novel fusion method, we create a hybrid model incorporating a genetic algorithm-optimized Simpson formula for mechanistic modeling and a Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) neural network to address the challenge of soft flow measurement in multiphase pipelines. Further, a hybrid model comprising Random Forest (RF), Gradient Boosting Trees (XGBoost), and Artificial Neural Network (ANN) achieves intelligent and efficient operation and maintenance of oil-gas-water multiphase pipelines. On-site validation in the HXL oil-site demonstrates the hybrid model's high accuracy in predicting pipeline flow (93.7% accuracy, average error of 2.89 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/d). The model also exhibits a diagnostic accuracy exceeding 90% for incidents such as pipeline blockages, leaks, and ruptures, with a leak location detection precision surpassing 90%. This study highlights the significant and superior performance of a hybrid modeling approach, establishing it as a crucial technique for intelligent operation and maintenance of oil-gas-water multiphase pipelines.
